~~~~python
"""Frozen orthographic and Brown--Conrady observation operators."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Callable

import numpy as np

from .contracts import (
    MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES,
    ValidationIssue,
    as_vector3,
    is_finite_number,
    reject_unknown_keys,
    safe_uniform_sample_count,
    strict_finite_array,
)


def _record_times(spec: Any, path: str, issues: list[ValidationIssue]) -> np.ndarray:
    if isinstance(spec, list):
        values = strict_finite_array(spec)
        conversion_ok = values is not None
        if values is None:
            values = np.empty(0)
        if not conversion_ok or values.ndim != 1:
            issues.append(
                ValidationIssue("OBS_TIME", path, spec, "finite one-dimensional time list")
            )
            return np.empty(0)
        if values.size > MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES:
            issues.append(
                ValidationIssue(
                    "OBS_TIME",
                    path,
                    int(values.size),
                    f"at most {MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES} observation times",
                )
            )
            return np.empty(0)
        return values
    if isinstance(spec, dict) and spec.get("kind") == "uniform":
        reject_unknown_keys(
            spec, {"kind", "start", "stop", "step"}, path, issues
        )
        start, stop, step = spec.get("start"), spec.get("stop"), spec.get("step")
        if not all(is_finite_number(v) for v in (start, stop, step)) or float(step) <= 0:
            issues.append(
                ValidationIssue(
                    "OBS_TIME",
                    path,
                    spec,
                    "uniform times with finite start/stop and step > 0",
                )
            )
            return np.empty(0)
        start, stop, step = float(start), float(stop), float(step)
        if stop < start:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_TIME", path, spec, "stop >= start"))
            return np.empty(0)
        count = safe_uniform_sample_count(
            stop - start,
            step,
            maximum_samples=MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES,
        )
        if count is None:
            issues.append(
                ValidationIssue(
                    "OBS_TIME",
                    path,
                    spec,
                    f"uniform grid with at most {MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES} samples",
                )
            )
            return np.empty(0)
        values = start + step * np.arange(count)
        if values.size == 0 or values[-1] < stop - 1e-12 * max(1.0, abs(stop)):
            values = np.append(values, stop)
        else:
            values[-1] = min(values[-1], stop)
        return values
    issues.append(
        ValidationIssue(
            "OBS_TIME",
            path,
            spec,
            "finite list or {kind:'uniform', start, stop, step}",
        )
    )
    return np.empty(0)


def evaluate_observations(
    spec: Any,
    *,
    position_at: Callable[[np.ndarray], np.ndarray],
    interval_end: float,
    completed: bool,
    e_z: np.ndarray,
    event_time_tolerance: float,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate an optional observation input without changing physics status."""

    if spec is None:
        return {}
    issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_TYPE", "observation", spec, "object"))
        return _invalid_observation(issues)
    obs_type = spec.get("type")
    obs_type_key = obs_type if isinstance(obs_type, str) else None
    observation_allowed = {
        "orthographic": {
            "type",
            "axis_1",
            "axis_2",
            "t0",
            "record_times",
        },
        "camera_brown_conrady": {
            "type",
            "R_c",
            "c_c",
            "f_x",
            "f_y",
            "c_x",
            "c_y",
            "k1",
            "k2",
            "k3",
            "p1",
            "p2",
            "Omega_cal",
            "t0",
            "record_times",
        },
    }.get(obs_type_key, {"type", "t0", "record_times"})
    reject_unknown_keys(spec, observation_allowed, "observation", issues)
    t0 = spec.get("t0")
    if not is_finite_number(t0):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_TIME", "observation.t0", t0, "finite real"))
        t0 = 0.0
    record = _record_times(spec.get("record_times"), "observation.record_times", issues)
    model_times = record + float(t0)

    static: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if obs_type == "orthographic":
        axis_1 = as_vector3(spec.get("axis_1"), "observation.axis_1", issues)
        axis_2 = as_vector3(spec.get("axis_2"), "observation.axis_2", issues)
        tol = 1e-10
        if abs(np.linalg.norm(axis_1) - 1.0) > tol:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_AXIS", "observation.axis_1", axis_1, "unit vector"))
        if abs(np.linalg.norm(axis_2) - 1.0) > tol:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_AXIS", "observation.axis_2", axis_2, "unit vector"))
        if abs(float(axis_1 @ axis_2)) > tol:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_AXIS", "observation.axes", [axis_1, axis_2], "orthogonal"))
        if abs(float(axis_1 @ e_z)) > tol or abs(float(axis_2 @ e_z)) > tol:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_AXIS", "observation.axes", [axis_1, axis_2], "horizontal"))
        static = {"axis_1": axis_1, "axis_2": axis_2}
    elif obs_type == "camera_brown_conrady":
        rotation_raw = spec.get("R_c")
        rotation = strict_finite_array(rotation_raw)
        if rotation is None:
            rotation = np.zeros((3, 3))
        if rotation.shape != (3, 3) or not np.all(np.isfinite(rotation)):
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_CAMERA", "observation.R_c", rotation_raw, "finite 3x3 rotation"))
            rotation = np.eye(3)
        elif not (
            np.linalg.norm(rotation.T @ rotation - np.eye(3), ord=np.inf) <= 1e-9
            and abs(np.linalg.det(rotation) - 1.0) <= 1e-9
        ):
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_CAMERA", "observation.R_c", rotation, "member of SO(3)"))
        center = as_vector3(spec.get("c_c"), "observation.c_c", issues)
        scalars = {}
        for key in ("f_x", "f_y", "c_x", "c_y", "k1", "k2", "k3", "p1", "p2"):
            value = spec.get(key)
            if not is_finite_number(value):
                issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_CAMERA", f"observation.{key}", value, "finite real"))
                value = 0.0
            scalars[key] = float(value)
        if scalars["f_x"] <= 0 or scalars["f_y"] <= 0:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("OBS_CAMERA", "observation.focal", [scalars["f_x"], scalars["f_y"]], "positive"))
        omega = spec.get("Omega_cal")
        omega_arr = strict_finite_array(omega)
        if omega_arr is None:
            omega_arr = np.zeros(4)
        if (
            omega_arr.shape != (4,)
            or not np.all(np.isfinite(omega_arr))
            or not (omega_arr[0] < omega_arr[1] and omega_arr[2] < omega_arr[3])
        ):
            issues.append(
                ValidationIssue(
                    "OBS_CAMERA",
                    "observation.Omega_cal",
                    omega,
                    "[x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max] with strict bounds",
                )
            )
            omega_arr = np.array([-1.0, 1.0, -1.0, 1.0])
        static = {"R_c": rotation, "c_c": center, "Omega_cal": omega_arr, **scalars}
    else:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "OBS_OPERATOR",
                "observation.type",
                obs_type,
                "orthographic or camera_brown_conrady",
            )
        )

    if issues:
        return _invalid_observation(issues)

    if completed:
        in_return = (model_times >= 0.0) & (model_times <= interval_end)
    else:
        in_return = (model_times >= 0.0) & (model_times < interval_end)
    candidate_indices = np.flatnonzero(in_return)
    candidate_times = model_times[candidate_indices]
    positions = (
        np.asarray(position_at(candidate_times), dtype=float)
        if candidate_times.size
        else np.empty((0, 3))
    )
    values = np.full((record.size, 2), np.nan)
    valid = np.zeros(record.size, dtype=bool)
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for index in np.flatnonzero(~in_return):
        reasons.append({"index": int(index), "code": "OUTSIDE_RETURN_INTERVAL"})

    if obs_type == "orthographic":
        projected = np.column_stack((positions @ static["axis_1"], positions @ static["axis_2"]))
        values[candidate_indices] = projected
        valid[candidate_indices] = True
    else:
        with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
            camera = (static["R_c"] @ (positions - static["c_c"]).T).T
        for local, index in enumerate(candidate_indices):
            Xc, Yc, Zc = camera[local]
            if not np.all(np.isfinite(camera[local])):
                reasons.append(
                    {
                        "index": int(index),
                        "code": "OBSERVATION_NUMERICAL_NONFINITE",
                        "stage": "camera_coordinates",
                    }
                )
                continue
            if not Zc > 0.0:
                reasons.append({"index": int(index), "code": "CAMERA_BEHIND_OR_ON_PLANE", "Z_c": float(Zc)})
                continue
            with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
                xn, yn = Xc / Zc, Yc / Zc
            if not (np.isfinite(xn) and np.isfinite(yn)):
                reasons.append(
                    {
                        "index": int(index),
                        "code": "OBSERVATION_NUMERICAL_NONFINITE",
                        "stage": "normalized_coordinates",
                    }
                )
                continue
            xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax = static["Omega_cal"]
            if not (xmin < xn < xmax and ymin < yn < ymax):
                reasons.append({"index": int(index), "code": "OUTSIDE_CALIBRATION_DOMAIN", "x_n": float(xn), "y_n": float(yn)})
                continue
            with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
                radius2 = xn * xn + yn * yn
                radial = 1 + static["k1"] * radius2 + static["k2"] * radius2**2 + static["k3"] * radius2**3
                xd = xn * radial + 2 * static["p1"] * xn * yn + static["p2"] * (radius2 + 2 * xn * xn)
                yd = yn * radial + static["p1"] * (radius2 + 2 * yn * yn) + 2 * static["p2"] * xn * yn
                pixel = np.asarray(
                    [
                        static["f_x"] * xd + static["c_x"],
                        static["f_y"] * yd + static["c_y"],
                    ],
                    dtype=float,
                )
            if not (
                np.isfinite(radius2)
                and np.isfinite(radial)
                and np.isfinite(xd)
                and np.isfinite(yd)
                and np.all(np.isfinite(pixel))
            ):
                reasons.append(
                    {
                        "index": int(index),
                        "code": "OBSERVATION_NUMERICAL_NONFINITE",
                        "stage": "distortion_or_pixel",
                    }
                )
                continue
            values[index] = pixel
            valid[index] = True

    ambiguous = np.abs(model_times - interval_end) <= event_time_tolerance if not completed else np.zeros(record.size, dtype=bool)
    for index in np.flatnonzero(ambiguous):
        reasons.append({"index": int(index), "code": "OBSERVATION_EVENT_AMBIGUOUS"})

    return {
        "status": ["OBSERVATION_INPUT_VALID"],
        "operator": obs_type,
        "record_time": record,
        "model_time": model_times,
        "time": model_times,
        "values": values,
        "valid_mask": valid,
        "errors": reasons,
        "event_ambiguous_mask": ambiguous,
    }


def _invalid_observation(issues: list[ValidationIssue]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": ["INVALID_OBSERVATION_INPUT"],
        "operator": None,
        "time": np.empty(0),
        "values": np.empty((0, 2)),
        "valid_mask": np.empty(0, dtype=bool),
        "errors": [issue.as_dict() for issue in issues],
    }
~~~~

# Layer 2 source: providers.py

~~~~python
"""Registered, auditable input providers for JSON configurations.

Library users may add provider factories to the registries before constructing
a model.  This is the deliberate extension seam for future theory revisions;
unknown provider kinds fail closed instead of silently becoming zero inputs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Callable

import numpy as np

from .contracts import (
    ValidationIssue,
    as_vector3,
    is_finite_number,
    reject_unknown_keys,
    strict_finite_array,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PrescribedMotion:
    position_fn: Callable[[float], np.ndarray]
    velocity_fn: Callable[[float], np.ndarray]
    acceleration_fn: Callable[[float], np.ndarray]
    description: dict[str, Any]

    def position(self, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.asarray(self.position_fn(float(t)), dtype=float)

    def velocity(self, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.asarray(self.velocity_fn(float(t)), dtype=float)

    def acceleration(self, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.asarray(self.acceleration_fn(float(t)), dtype=float)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AirVelocity:
    value_fn: Callable[[np.ndarray, float], np.ndarray]
    description: dict[str, Any]

    def value(self, position: np.ndarray, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.asarray(self.value_fn(np.asarray(position, dtype=float), float(t)), dtype=float)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MaterialForce:
    value_fn: Callable[[float, float], np.ndarray]
    description: dict[str, Any]

    def value(self, xi: float, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.asarray(self.value_fn(float(xi), float(t)), dtype=float)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PointForce:
    value_fn: Callable[[float], np.ndarray]
    description: dict[str, Any]

    def value(self, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.asarray(self.value_fn(float(t)), dtype=float)


MOTION_FACTORIES: dict[str, Callable[..., PrescribedMotion]] = {}
AIR_FACTORIES: dict[str, Callable[..., AirVelocity]] = {}
MATERIAL_FORCE_FACTORIES: dict[str, Callable[..., MaterialForce]] = {}
POINT_FORCE_FACTORIES: dict[str, Callable[..., PointForce]] = {}


def _motion_constant(spec, path, issues):
    value = as_vector3(spec.get("value"), f"{path}.value", issues)
    zero = np.zeros(3)
    return PrescribedMotion(
        lambda _t, value=value: value.copy(),
        lambda _t, zero=zero: zero.copy(),
        lambda _t, zero=zero: zero.copy(),
        dict(spec),
    )


def _motion_harmonic(spec, path, issues):
    offset = as_vector3(spec.get("offset"), f"{path}.offset", issues)
    amplitude = as_vector3(spec.get("amplitude"), f"{path}.amplitude", issues)
    omega = spec.get("omega")
    phase = spec.get("phase", 0.0)
    if not is_finite_number(omega):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", f"{path}.omega", omega, "finite real number"))
        omega = 0.0
    if not is_finite_number(phase):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", f"{path}.phase", phase, "finite real number"))
        phase = 0.0
    omega = float(omega)
    phase = float(phase)
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        velocity_amplitude = amplitude * omega
        acceleration_amplitude = velocity_amplitude * omega
    if not (
        np.all(np.isfinite(velocity_amplitude))
        and np.all(np.isfinite(acceleration_amplitude))
    ):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_DERIVATIVE",
                path,
                {
                    "amplitude": spec.get("amplitude"),
                    "omega": spec.get("omega"),
                },
                "finite amplitude*omega and amplitude*omega^2",
            )
        )
        # Preserve aggregate validation without letting later compatibility
        # checks evaluate an already-known overflowing provider.
        velocity_amplitude = np.zeros(3)
        acceleration_amplitude = np.zeros(3)
    return PrescribedMotion(
        lambda t: offset + amplitude * np.sin(omega * t + phase),
        lambda t: velocity_amplitude * np.cos(omega * t + phase),
        lambda t: -acceleration_amplitude * np.sin(omega * t + phase),
        dict(spec),
    )


def _motion_polynomial(spec, path, issues):
    raw = spec.get("coefficients")
    coefficients = strict_finite_array(raw)
    conversion_ok = coefficients is not None
    if coefficients is None:
        coefficients = np.zeros((1, 3))
    if (
        not conversion_ok
        or coefficients.ndim != 2
        or coefficients.shape[1] != 3
        or coefficients.shape[0] < 1
    ):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "TYPE",
                f"{path}.coefficients",
                raw,
                "nonempty finite array [power, xyz] for sum c_k t^k",
            )
        )
        coefficients = np.zeros((1, 3))

    def evaluate(t, derivative):
        out = np.zeros(3)
        for power in range(derivative, coefficients.shape[0]):
            factor = 1.0
            for k in range(derivative):
                factor *= power - k
            out += factor * coefficients[power] * t ** (power - derivative)
        return out

    return PrescribedMotion(
        lambda t: evaluate(t, 0),
        lambda t: evaluate(t, 1),
        lambda t: evaluate(t, 2),
        dict(spec),
    )


def _air_zero(spec, _path, _issues):
    return AirVelocity(lambda _r, _t: np.zeros(3), dict(spec))


def _air_constant(spec, path, issues):
    value = as_vector3(spec.get("value"), f"{path}.value", issues)
    return AirVelocity(lambda _r, _t: value.copy(), dict(spec))


def _air_affine(spec, path, issues):
    offset = as_vector3(spec.get("offset"), f"{path}.offset", issues)
    time_rate = as_vector3(spec.get("time_rate", [0, 0, 0]), f"{path}.time_rate", issues)
    raw = spec.get("matrix")
    matrix = strict_finite_array(raw)
    conversion_ok = matrix is not None
    if matrix is None:
        matrix = np.zeros((3, 3))
    if not conversion_ok or matrix.shape != (3, 3):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue("TYPE", f"{path}.matrix", raw, "finite 3x3 matrix")
        )
        matrix = np.zeros((3, 3))
    return AirVelocity(lambda r, t: offset + matrix @ r + time_rate * t, dict(spec))


def _time_vector(spec, path, issues) -> Callable[[float], np.ndarray]:
    kind = spec.get("kind")
    if kind == "zero":
        return lambda _t: np.zeros(3)
    if kind == "constant":
        value = as_vector3(spec.get("value"), f"{path}.value", issues)
        return lambda _t: value.copy()
    if kind == "harmonic":
        offset = as_vector3(spec.get("offset", [0, 0, 0]), f"{path}.offset", issues)
        amplitude = as_vector3(spec.get("amplitude"), f"{path}.amplitude", issues)
        omega = spec.get("omega")
        phase = spec.get("phase", 0.0)
        if not is_finite_number(omega):
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", f"{path}.omega", omega, "finite real number"))
            omega = 0.0
        if not is_finite_number(phase):
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", f"{path}.phase", phase, "finite real number"))
            phase = 0.0
        return lambda t: offset + amplitude * np.sin(float(omega) * t + float(phase))
    issues.append(
        ValidationIssue(
            "PROVIDER_KIND",
            f"{path}.kind",
            kind,
            "one of zero, constant, harmonic",
        )
    )
    return lambda _t: np.zeros(3)


def _point_registered(spec, path, issues):
    fn = _time_vector(spec, path, issues)
    return PointForce(fn, dict(spec))


def _material_registered(spec, path, issues):
    time_fn = _time_vector(spec, path, issues)
    spatial_raw = spec.get("spatial_coefficients", [1.0])
    spatial = strict_finite_array(spatial_raw)
    conversion_ok = spatial is not None
    if spatial is None:
        spatial = np.ones(1)
    if not conversion_ok or spatial.ndim != 1 or spatial.size < 1:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "TYPE",
                f"{path}.spatial_coefficients",
                spatial_raw,
                "finite coefficients for sum a_k xi^k",
            )
        )
        spatial = np.ones(1)

    def value(xi, t):
        factor = sum(coef * xi**power for power, coef in enumerate(spatial))
        return factor * time_fn(t)

    return MaterialForce(value, dict(spec))


MOTION_FACTORIES.update(
    constant=_motion_constant,
    harmonic=_motion_harmonic,
    polynomial=_motion_polynomial,
)
AIR_FACTORIES.update(zero=_air_zero, constant=_air_constant, affine=_air_affine)
for _kind in ("zero", "constant", "harmonic"):
    POINT_FORCE_FACTORIES[_kind] = _point_registered
    MATERIAL_FORCE_FACTORIES[_kind] = _material_registered


def build_motion(spec: Any, path: str, issues: list[ValidationIssue]) -> PrescribedMotion:
    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", path, spec, "provider object"))
        spec = {"kind": "constant", "value": [0, 0, 0]}
    kind = spec.get("kind")
    kind_key = kind if isinstance(kind, str) else None
    allowed = {
        "constant": {"kind", "value"},
        "harmonic": {"kind", "offset", "amplitude", "omega", "phase"},
        "polynomial": {"kind", "coefficients"},
    }.get(kind_key, {"kind"})
    reject_unknown_keys(spec, allowed, path, issues)
    factory = MOTION_FACTORIES.get(kind_key)
    if factory is None:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_KIND",
                f"{path}.kind",
                spec.get("kind"),
                f"registered motion kind: {sorted(MOTION_FACTORIES)}",
            )
        )
        factory = _motion_constant
        spec = {"kind": "constant", "value": [0, 0, 0]}
    return factory(spec, path, issues)


def validate_motion_window(
    motion: PrescribedMotion,
    T: float,
    path: str,
    issues: list[ValidationIssue],
) -> None:
    """Prove registered motion formulas stay finite on the frozen time window.

    The registered harmonic and polynomial families admit a direct envelope
    check.  This rejects finite JSON scalars whose products (for example
    ``omega*T`` or ``c_k*T**k``) overflow before the ODE solver is called.
    """

    if not is_finite_number(T) or float(T) < 0.0:
        return
    duration = float(T)
    description = motion.description
    kind = description.get("kind")
    finite_envelope = True
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
        if kind == "harmonic":
            omega = description.get("omega")
            phase = description.get("phase", 0.0)
            offset = strict_finite_array(description.get("offset"))
            amplitude = strict_finite_array(description.get("amplitude"))
            phase_end = np.add(
                np.multiply(float(omega), duration), float(phase)
            ) if is_finite_number(omega) and is_finite_number(phase) else np.inf
            finite_envelope = bool(
                is_finite_number(omega)
                and is_finite_number(phase)
                and np.isfinite(phase_end)
                and offset is not None
                and offset.shape == (3,)
                and amplitude is not None
                and amplitude.shape == (3,)
                and np.all(np.isfinite(np.abs(offset) + np.abs(amplitude)))
            )
        elif kind == "polynomial":
            coefficients = strict_finite_array(description.get("coefficients"))
            finite_envelope = coefficients is not None
            if finite_envelope:
                assert coefficients is not None
                for derivative in (0, 1, 2):
                    envelope = np.zeros(3)
                    for power in range(derivative, coefficients.shape[0]):
                        factor = 1.0
                        for offset in range(derivative):
                            factor *= power - offset
                        try:
                            time_power = np.power(
                                duration, power - derivative
                            )
                            term = (
                                np.abs(coefficients[power])
                                * factor
                                * time_power
                            )
                            envelope = envelope + term
                        except (FloatingPointError, OverflowError, ValueError):
                            finite_envelope = False
                            break
                        if not (
                            np.all(np.isfinite(term))
                            and np.all(np.isfinite(envelope))
                        ):
                            finite_envelope = False
                            break
                    if not finite_envelope:
                        break
    sampled_finite = True
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
        for t_value in (0.0, 0.5 * duration, duration):
            try:
                values = (
                    motion.position(t_value),
                    motion.velocity(t_value),
                    motion.acceleration(t_value),
                )
            except Exception:
                sampled_finite = False
                break
            if any(
                np.asarray(value).shape != (3,)
                or not np.all(np.isfinite(value))
                for value in values
            ):
                sampled_finite = False
                break
    if not finite_envelope or not sampled_finite:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_WINDOW",
                path,
                description,
                "finite C2 registered motion on every t in [0,T]",
            )
        )


def validate_force_window(
    force: PointForce | MaterialForce,
    T: float,
    path: str,
    issues: list[ValidationIssue],
) -> None:
    """Validate time phase and spatial envelope for registered force providers."""

    if not is_finite_number(T) or float(T) < 0.0:
        return
    duration = float(T)
    description = force.description
    valid = True
    temporal_envelope = np.zeros(3)
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
        kind = description.get("kind")
        if kind == "harmonic":
            omega = description.get("omega")
            phase = description.get("phase", 0.0)
            offset = strict_finite_array(description.get("offset", [0, 0, 0]))
            amplitude = strict_finite_array(description.get("amplitude"))
            if not (
                is_finite_number(omega)
                and is_finite_number(phase)
                and offset is not None
                and offset.shape == (3,)
                and amplitude is not None
                and amplitude.shape == (3,)
            ):
                valid = False
            else:
                phase_end = np.add(
                    np.multiply(float(omega), duration), float(phase)
                )
                temporal_envelope = np.abs(offset) + np.abs(amplitude)
                valid = bool(
                    np.isfinite(phase_end)
                    and np.all(np.isfinite(temporal_envelope))
                )
        elif kind == "constant":
            constant = strict_finite_array(description.get("value"))
            if constant is None or constant.shape != (3,):
                valid = False
            else:
                temporal_envelope = np.abs(constant)
        if isinstance(force, MaterialForce):
            coefficients = strict_finite_array(
                description.get("spatial_coefficients", [1.0])
            )
            if coefficients is None or coefficients.ndim != 1:
                valid = False
            else:
                spatial_envelope = np.sum(np.abs(coefficients))
                if not (
                    np.isfinite(spatial_envelope)
                    and np.all(
                        np.isfinite(spatial_envelope * temporal_envelope)
                    )
                ):
                    valid = False
        times = (0.0, 0.5 * duration, duration)
        try:
            if isinstance(force, MaterialForce):
                samples = [
                    force.value(xi, t_value)
                    for xi in (0.0, 0.5, 1.0)
                    for t_value in times
                ]
            else:
                samples = [force.value(t_value) for t_value in times]
        except Exception:
            valid = False
            samples = []
    if not valid or any(
        np.asarray(value).shape != (3,)
        or not np.all(np.isfinite(value))
        for value in samples
    ):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_WINDOW",
                path,
                description,
                "finite registered force on its full [0,T] input domain",
            )
        )


def validate_air_window(
    air: AirVelocity,
    T: float,
    reference_positions: list[np.ndarray],
    path: str,
    issues: list[ValidationIssue],
) -> None:
    """Validate affine time terms and representative finite-state evaluations."""

    if not is_finite_number(T) or float(T) < 0.0:
        return
    duration = float(T)
    description = air.description
    valid = True
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
        if description.get("kind") == "affine":
            offset = strict_finite_array(description.get("offset"))
            time_rate = strict_finite_array(
                description.get("time_rate", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
            )
            matrix = strict_finite_array(description.get("matrix"))
            if (
                offset is None
                or offset.shape != (3,)
                or time_rate is None
                or time_rate.shape != (3,)
                or matrix is None
                or matrix.shape != (3, 3)
            ):
                valid = False
            else:
                temporal_envelope = (
                    np.abs(offset) + np.abs(time_rate) * duration
                )
                valid = bool(np.all(np.isfinite(temporal_envelope)))
                for position in reference_positions:
                    position_array = strict_finite_array(position)
                    if position_array is None or position_array.shape != (3,):
                        valid = False
                        break
                    state_envelope = (
                        temporal_envelope
                        + np.abs(matrix) @ np.abs(position_array)
                    )
                    if not np.all(np.isfinite(state_envelope)):
                        valid = False
                        break
        try:
            samples = [
                air.value(position, t_value)
                for position in reference_positions
                for t_value in (0.0, 0.5 * duration, duration)
            ]
        except Exception:
            valid = False
            samples = []
    if not valid or any(
        np.asarray(value).shape != (3,)
        or not np.all(np.isfinite(value))
        for value in samples
    ):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_WINDOW",
                path,
                description,
                "finite registered air velocity over [0,T] at finite reference states",
            )
        )


def build_air(spec: Any, path: str, issues: list[ValidationIssue]) -> AirVelocity:
    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", path, spec, "provider object"))
        spec = {"kind": "zero"}
    kind = spec.get("kind")
    kind_key = kind if isinstance(kind, str) else None
    allowed = {
        "zero": {"kind"},
        "constant": {"kind", "value"},
        "affine": {"kind", "offset", "matrix", "time_rate"},
    }.get(kind_key, {"kind"})
    reject_unknown_keys(spec, allowed, path, issues)
    factory = AIR_FACTORIES.get(kind_key)
    if factory is None:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_KIND",
                f"{path}.kind",
                spec.get("kind"),
                f"registered air kind: {sorted(AIR_FACTORIES)}",
            )
        )
        factory = _air_zero
        spec = {"kind": "zero"}
    return factory(spec, path, issues)


def build_point_force(spec: Any, path: str, issues: list[ValidationIssue]) -> PointForce:
    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", path, spec, "provider object"))
        spec = {"kind": "zero"}
    kind = spec.get("kind")
    kind_key = kind if isinstance(kind, str) else None
    allowed = {
        "zero": {"kind"},
        "constant": {"kind", "value"},
        "harmonic": {"kind", "offset", "amplitude", "omega", "phase"},
    }.get(kind_key, {"kind"})
    reject_unknown_keys(spec, allowed, path, issues)
    factory = POINT_FORCE_FACTORIES.get(kind_key)
    if factory is None:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_KIND",
                f"{path}.kind",
                spec.get("kind"),
                f"registered point-force kind: {sorted(POINT_FORCE_FACTORIES)}",
            )
        )
        factory = _point_registered
        spec = {"kind": "zero"}
    return factory(spec, path, issues)


def build_material_force(spec: Any, path: str, issues: list[ValidationIssue]) -> MaterialForce:
    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", path, spec, "provider object"))
        spec = {"kind": "zero"}
    kind = spec.get("kind")
    kind_key = kind if isinstance(kind, str) else None
    allowed = {
        "zero": {"kind", "spatial_coefficients"},
        "constant": {"kind", "value", "spatial_coefficients"},
        "harmonic": {
            "kind",
            "offset",
            "amplitude",
            "omega",
            "phase",
            "spatial_coefficients",
        },
    }.get(kind_key, {"kind"})
    reject_unknown_keys(spec, allowed, path, issues)
    factory = MATERIAL_FORCE_FACTORIES.get(kind_key)
    if factory is None:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "PROVIDER_KIND",
                f"{path}.kind",
                spec.get("kind"),
                f"registered material-force kind: {sorted(MATERIAL_FORCE_FACTORIES)}",
            )
        )
        factory = _material_registered
        spec = {"kind": "zero"}
    return factory(spec, path, issues)
~~~~

# Layer 2 source: runner.py

~~~~python
"""Model dispatch for the two frozen forward-theory numerical backends."""

from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from .cable import run_cable
from .contracts import (
    CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    SimulationResult,
    THEORY_SHA256,
    ValidationIssue,
    json_input_issues,
    load_json,
    run_identity_hashes,
    source_tree_sha256,
)
from .torus import run_torus


def run_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> SimulationResult:
    """Run one immutable input snapshot and bind identity at dispatch time.

    The caller's mapping may be mutable.  Copying it before either validation
    or hashing prevents a concurrent mutation from making the reported hash
    describe a different input than the one actually executed.  Backends are
    given the same run-start identity on every return path.
    """

    copy_issue: ValidationIssue | None = None
    try:
        frozen_config = deepcopy(config)
    except Exception as exc:
        copy_issue = ValidationIssue(
            "CONFIG_COPY_FAILURE",
            "config",
            f"<{type(exc).__name__}>",
            "deep-copyable finite JSON object",
        )
        frozen_config = {
            "invalid_root_type": type(config).__name__,
            "copy_failure": type(exc).__name__,
        }
    identity = run_identity_hashes(
        frozen_config
        if isinstance(frozen_config, dict)
        else {"invalid_root_type": type(frozen_config).__name__}
    )
    model_id = (
        frozen_config.get("model_id")
        if isinstance(frozen_config, dict)
        else None
    )
    if copy_issue is not None:
        input_issues = [copy_issue]
    elif not isinstance(frozen_config, dict):
        input_issues = [
            ValidationIssue(
                "CONFIG_ROOT_TYPE",
                "config",
                f"<{type(frozen_config).__name__}>",
                "JSON object",
            )
        ]
    else:
        input_issues = json_input_issues(frozen_config, "config")
    if input_issues:
        namespaces = {_issue_namespace(issue) for issue in input_issues}
        physical_invalid = "physical" in namespaces
        numerical_invalid = "numerics" in namespaces
        observation_invalid = "observation" in namespaces
        numerical_status = (
            "INVALID_NUMERICAL_CONFIG"
            if numerical_invalid
            else "INPUT_REJECTED"
        )
        observations = {}
        if observation_invalid:
            observations = {
                "status": ["INVALID_OBSERVATION_INPUT"],
                "operator": None,
                "time": np.empty(0),
                "values": np.empty((0, 2)),
                "valid_mask": np.empty(0, dtype=bool),
                "errors": [
                    issue.as_dict()
                    for issue in input_issues
                    if _issue_namespace(issue) == "observation"
                ],
            }
        return SimulationResult(
            model_id=(
                model_id if isinstance(model_id, str) else "UNSPECIFIED"
            ),
            # Only malformed physical/model inputs are allowed to establish
            # the frozen theory's INVALID_INPUT result.  A non-canonical
            # numerical, observation, metadata, or envelope field is a
            # software-input rejection, not a physical conclusion.
            contract_status=["INVALID_INPUT"] if physical_invalid else [],
            numerical_status=numerical_status,
            tau=0.0,
            returned_interval="empty",
            time=np.empty(0),
            observations=observations,
            events=[
                {
                    "kind": "input_validation",
                    "invalid_namespaces": sorted(namespaces),
                    "failures": [issue.as_dict() for issue in input_issues],
                }
            ],
            metadata=identity,
        )
    envelope_issues = _config_envelope_issues(frozen_config, model_id)
    if envelope_issues:
        return SimulationResult(
            model_id=(model_id if isinstance(model_id, str) else "UNSPECIFIED"),
            contract_status=[],
            numerical_status="INPUT_REJECTED",
            tau=0.0,
            returned_interval="empty",
            time=np.empty(0),
            events=[
                {
                    "kind": "config_envelope",
                    "failures": [issue.as_dict() for issue in envelope_issues],
                }
            ],
            metadata=identity,
        )
    if model_id == "FWD-CABLE-1.0":
        result = run_cable(frozen_config, identity=identity)
        return _fail_on_source_drift(result, identity)
    if model_id == "FWD-TORUS-1.0":
        result = run_torus(frozen_config, identity=identity)
        return _fail_on_source_drift(result, identity)
    issue = ValidationIssue(
        "MODEL_ID",
        "model_id",
        model_id,
        "FWD-CABLE-1.0 or FWD-TORUS-1.0",
    )
    return SimulationResult(
        model_id=str(model_id) if model_id is not None else "UNSPECIFIED",
        contract_status=["INVALID_INPUT"],
        numerical_status="INPUT_REJECTED",
        tau=0.0,
        returned_interval="empty",
        time=np.empty(0),
        events=[{"kind": "input", "failures": [issue.as_dict()]}],
        metadata=identity,
    )


def _issue_namespace(issue: ValidationIssue) -> str:
    """Map a whole-config JSON issue to the contract layer it belongs to."""

    path = issue.path
    if path == "config.numerics" or path.startswith("config.numerics.") or path.startswith(
        "config.numerics["
    ):
        return "numerics"
    if path == "config.observation" or path.startswith(
        "config.observation."
    ) or path.startswith("config.observation["):
        return "observation"
    physical_roots = (
        "config.physical",
        "config.inputs",
        "config.initial_state",
        "config.model_id",
        "config.units",
    )
    if any(
        path == root or path.startswith(root + ".") or path.startswith(root + "[")
        for root in physical_roots
    ):
        return "physical"
    return "config_envelope"


def _config_envelope_issues(
    config: dict[str, Any], model_id: Any
) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
    """Validate software-envelope identity without declaring physical failure."""

    issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
    if config.get("schema_version") != CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "SCHEMA_VERSION",
                "schema_version",
                config.get("schema_version"),
                CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            )
        )
    if config.get("theory_sha256") != THEORY_SHA256:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "THEORY_IDENTITY",
                "theory_sha256",
                config.get("theory_sha256"),
                THEORY_SHA256,
            )
        )
    common = {
        "schema_version",
        "model_id",
        "theory_sha256",
        "units",
        "physical",
        "numerics",
        "observation",
        "validation",
        "metadata",
    }
    allowed = set(common)
    if model_id == "FWD-CABLE-1.0":
        allowed.update({"inputs", "initial_state"})
    for key in sorted(set(config) - allowed):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "UNKNOWN_FIELD",
                key,
                config[key],
                f"one of {sorted(allowed)}",
            )
        )
    return issues


def _fail_on_source_drift(
    result: SimulationResult, run_start_identity: dict[str, Any]
) -> SimulationResult:
    """A result cannot be qualified if source files changed during its run."""

    source_end = source_tree_sha256()
    source_start = run_start_identity["source_tree_sha256"]
    result.metadata["source_tree_sha256_at_end"] = source_end
    result.metadata["source_tree_stable_during_run"] = source_end == source_start
    if source_end == source_start:
        return result
    previous_status = {
        "contract_status": list(result.contract_status),
        "numerical_status": result.numerical_status,
    }
    result.contract_status = []
    result.numerical_status = "SOURCE_DRIFT"
    result.returned_interval = "candidate only; source tree changed during run"
    result.events.append(
        {
            "kind": "source_drift",
            "source_tree_sha256_at_start": source_start,
            "source_tree_sha256_at_end": source_end,
            "discarded_status": previous_status,
        }
    )
    return result


def run_file(path: str | Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], SimulationResult]:
    config = load_json(path)
    return config, run_config(config)
~~~~

~~~~python
"""Independent numerical backend for the frozen FWD-TORUS-1.0 model."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any
import warnings

import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

from .contracts import (
    SimulationResult,
    MIN_SOLVER_RTOL,
    MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES,
    ValidationIssue,
    as_vector3,
    base_validation,
    is_finite_number,
    numerical_time_resource_issues,
    reject_unknown_keys,
    require_number,
    strict_finite_array,
    safe_uniform_sample_count,
)
from .observations import evaluate_observations


TORUS_NUMERICAL_FIELDS = {
    "method",
    "rtol",
    "atol",
    "atol_angle",
    "atol_rate",
    "max_step",
    "output_dt",
    "event_cluster_tolerance",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TorusParameters:
    A: np.ndarray
    B: np.ndarray
    e_z: np.ndarray
    g: float
    mass: float
    s_A: float
    s_B: float
    lower_length: float
    T: float
    initial_state: np.ndarray
    O: np.ndarray
    e_x: np.ndarray
    e_y: np.ndarray
    d: float
    x_C: float
    a_A: float
    a_B: float
    h: float


def validate_torus_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[ValidationIssue], TorusParameters | None]:
    issues = base_validation(config, "FWD-TORUS-1.0")
    reject_unknown_keys(
        config,
        {
            "schema_version",
            "model_id",
            "theory_sha256",
            "units",
            "physical",
            "numerics",
            "observation",
            "validation",
            "metadata",
        },
        "",
        issues,
    )
    if config.get("units") != "SI":
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("UNITS", "units", config.get("units"), "SI"))
    physical = config.get("physical")
    if not isinstance(physical, dict):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", "physical", physical, "object"))
        physical = {}
    reject_unknown_keys(
        physical,
        {
            "A",
            "B",
            "e_z",
            "g",
            "mass",
            "s_A",
            "s_B",
            "lower_length",
            "initial_state",
            "T",
        },
        "physical",
        issues,
    )
    A = as_vector3(physical.get("A"), "physical.A", issues)
    B = as_vector3(physical.get("B"), "physical.B", issues)
    e_z = as_vector3(physical.get("e_z"), "physical.e_z", issues)
    g = require_number(physical, "g", "physical", issues, positive=True)
    mass = require_number(physical, "mass", "physical", issues, positive=True)
    s_A = require_number(physical, "s_A", "physical", issues, positive=True)
    s_B = require_number(physical, "s_B", "physical", issues, positive=True)
    ell = require_number(physical, "lower_length", "physical", issues, positive=True)
    T = require_number(physical, "T", "physical", issues, positive=True)
    initial_raw = physical.get("initial_state")
    initial = strict_finite_array(initial_raw)
    if initial is None or initial.shape != (4,):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TYPE", "physical.initial_state", initial_raw, "four finite reals"))
        initial = np.zeros(4)
    d_vector = B - A
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(d_vector))
    geometry_ok = True
    if not d > 0.0:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_GEOMETRY", "physical.A,B", [A, B], "distinct support points"))
        geometry_ok = False
        e_x = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    else:
        e_x = d_vector / d
    if abs(np.linalg.norm(e_z) - 1.0) > 1e-10:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_GEOMETRY", "physical.e_z", e_z, "unit vector"))
        geometry_ok = False
    e_z_norm = float(np.linalg.norm(e_z))
    support_vertical_cosine = (
        abs(float(d_vector @ e_z)) / (d * e_z_norm)
        if d > 0.0 and e_z_norm > 0.0
        else np.inf
    )
    if d > 0 and support_vertical_cosine > 1e-10:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "TORUS_GEOMETRY",
                "physical.A,B,e_z",
                support_vertical_cosine,
                "dimensionless |(B-A) dot e_z|/(|B-A| |e_z|) <= 1e-10",
            )
        )
        geometry_ok = False
    e_y = np.cross(e_z, e_x)
    if not (abs(s_A - s_B) < d < s_A + s_B):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_GEOMETRY", "physical.s_A,s_B,A,B", [s_A, s_B, d], "strict sphere-intersection inequalities"))
        geometry_ok = False
    x_C = (s_A * s_A - s_B * s_B) / (2 * d) if d > 0 else 0.0
    a_A = x_C + d / 2
    a_B = d / 2 - x_C
    h2 = s_A * s_A - a_A * a_A
    if not (a_A > 0 and a_B > 0):
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_WORKING_BAND", "derived.a_A,a_B", [a_A, a_B], "both > 0"))
        geometry_ok = False
    if not h2 > 0:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_GEOMETRY", "derived.h2", h2, "> 0"))
        geometry_ok = False
    h = float(np.sqrt(max(h2, 0.0)))
    O = (A + B) / 2
    if geometry_ok:
        params = TorusParameters(A, B, e_z, g, mass, s_A, s_B, ell, T, initial, O, e_x, e_y, d, x_C, a_A, a_B, h)
        R0 = h + ell * np.cos(initial[0])
        derived0 = torus_derived(params, initial[None, :])
        initial_tensions = [float(derived0[key][0]) for key in ("T_A", "T_B", "T_lower")]
        if not R0 > 0:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_INITIAL", "physical.initial_state.R", R0, "> 0"))
        if not min(initial_tensions) > 0:
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("TORUS_INITIAL", "physical.initial_state.tensions", initial_tensions, "all > 0"))
    else:
        params = None
    return issues, params


def torus_rhs(params: TorusParameters, _t: float, state: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    phi, theta, phi_dot, theta_dot = state
    R = params.h + params.lower_length * np.cos(phi)
    if not R > 0.0:
        raise FloatingPointError("torus R left its positive domain")
    phi_ddot = -(
        R * np.sin(phi) * theta_dot * theta_dot
        + params.g * np.sin(phi) * np.cos(theta)
    ) / params.lower_length
    theta_ddot = (
        2 * params.lower_length * np.sin(phi) * phi_dot * theta_dot
        - params.g * np.sin(theta)
    ) / R
    return np.array([phi_dot, theta_dot, phi_ddot, theta_ddot])


def torus_derived(params: TorusParameters, states: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
    states = np.asarray(states, dtype=float)
    phi, theta, phi_dot, theta_dot = states.T
    ell = params.lower_length
    R = params.h + ell * np.cos(phi)
    e_r = np.sin(theta)[:, None] * params.e_y + np.cos(theta)[:, None] * params.e_z
    junction = params.O + params.x_C * params.e_x + params.h * e_r
    bob = (
        params.O
        + (params.x_C + ell * np.sin(phi))[:, None] * params.e_x
        + R[:, None] * e_r
    )
    T_lower = params.mass * (
        ell * phi_dot**2
        + R * np.cos(phi) * theta_dot**2
        + params.g * np.cos(phi) * np.cos(theta)
    )
    T_A = params.s_A * T_lower / params.d * (
        np.sin(phi) + params.a_B / params.h * np.cos(phi)
    )
    T_B = params.s_B * T_lower / params.d * (
        params.a_A / params.h * np.cos(phi) - np.sin(phi)
    )
    energy = (
        0.5 * params.mass * (ell * ell * phi_dot**2 + R * R * theta_dot**2)
        + params.mass * params.g * ((params.h + ell) - R * np.cos(theta))
    )
    relative = bob - params.O
    x = relative @ params.e_x
    y = relative @ params.e_y
    z = relative @ params.e_z
    r_perp = np.sqrt(y * y + z * z)
    Q_T = (x - params.x_C) ** 2 + r_perp**2 + params.h**2 - ell**2
    torus_residual = (x - params.x_C) ** 2 + (r_perp - params.h) ** 2 - ell**2
    return {
        "J": junction,
        "r_m": bob,
        "R": R,
        "T_A": T_A,
        "T_B": T_B,
        "T_lower": T_lower,
        "E_torus": energy,
        "r_perp": r_perp,
        "Q_T": Q_T,
        "torus_unsquared_residual": torus_residual,
        "physical_branch_residual": Q_T - 2 * params.h * r_perp,
    }


def run_torus(
    config: dict[str, Any], *, identity: dict[str, Any]
) -> SimulationResult:
    issues, params = validate_torus_config(config)
    if issues or params is None:
        return SimulationResult(
            model_id="FWD-TORUS-1.0",
            contract_status=["INVALID_INPUT"],
            numerical_status="INPUT_REJECTED",
            tau=0.0,
            returned_interval="empty",
            time=np.empty(0),
            events=[{"kind": "input", "failures": [issue.as_dict() for issue in issues]}],
            metadata=identity,
        )
    numerics = config.get("numerics", {})
    if not isinstance(numerics, dict):
        return _invalid_numerics(config, "numerics", numerics, "object", identity)
    numerical_issues = _validate_torus_numerics(numerics)
    if numerical_issues:
        return _invalid_numerical_issues(config, numerical_issues, identity)
    method = str(numerics.get("method", "DOP853"))
    rtol = float(numerics.get("rtol", 1e-9))
    atol = float(numerics.get("atol", 1e-11))
    atol_angle = float(numerics.get("atol_angle", atol))
    atol_rate = float(numerics.get("atol_rate", atol))
    max_step = float(numerics.get("max_step", params.T / 200.0))
    output_dt = float(numerics.get("output_dt", params.T / 1000))
    if not (np.isfinite(rtol) and rtol > 0 and np.isfinite(atol) and atol > 0 and np.isfinite(atol_angle) and atol_angle > 0 and np.isfinite(atol_rate) and atol_rate > 0 and max_step > 0 and np.isfinite(output_dt) and output_dt > 0):
        return _invalid_numerics(
            config,
            "numerics",
            numerics,
            "positive finite rtol, atol/atol_angle/atol_rate, output_dt; max_step > 0",
            identity,
        )
    resource_issues = numerical_time_resource_issues(
        params.T, max_step, output_dt
    )
    if resource_issues:
        return _invalid_numerical_issues(config, resource_issues, identity)
    atol_vector = np.array([atol_angle, atol_angle, atol_rate, atol_rate])

    event_names = ["R_ZERO", "T_A_ZERO", "T_B_ZERO", "T_LOWER_ZERO"]

    def guard_component(index):
        def event(_t, state):
            values = torus_derived(params, np.asarray(state)[None, :])
            return float([values["R"][0], values["T_A"][0], values["T_B"][0], values["T_lower"][0]][index])

        event.terminal = True
        event.direction = 0
        return event

    guards = [guard_component(index) for index in range(4)]
    try:
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught_warnings:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            sol = solve_ivp(
                lambda t, y: torus_rhs(params, t, y),
                (0.0, params.T),
                params.initial_state,
                method=method,
                rtol=rtol,
                atol=atol_vector,
                max_step=max_step,
                dense_output=True,
                events=guards,
            )
    except Exception as exc:  # numerical backend must return, not counterfeit physics
        return SimulationResult(
            model_id="FWD-TORUS-1.0",
            contract_status=[],
            numerical_status="SOLVER_FAILURE",
            tau=0.0,
            returned_interval="unresolved",
            time=np.empty(0),
            events=[{"kind": "numerical_failure", "message": repr(exc)}],
            metadata=identity,
        )
    solver_warnings = [
        {"category": item.category.__name__, "message": str(item.message)}
        for item in caught_warnings
    ]
    event_times = [float(times[0]) for times in sol.t_events if len(times)]
    event_tau = min(event_times) if event_times else np.inf
    event_tol = float(numerics.get("event_cluster_tolerance", 1e-9))
    if solver_warnings:
        tau = float(sol.t[-1]) if sol.t.size else 0.0
        completed = False
        contract_status = []
        numerical_status = "SOLVER_WARNING"
        returned_interval = f"[0,{tau}] candidate only; warning made status unresolved"
        events = [{"kind": "numerical_warning", "warnings": solver_warnings}]
    elif not sol.success:
        tau = float(sol.t[-1]) if sol.t.size else 0.0
        completed = False
        contract_status: list[str] = []
        numerical_status = "SOLVER_FAILURE"
        returned_interval = f"[0,{tau}] last accepted; physical status unresolved"
        events = [{"kind": "numerical_failure", "message": sol.message}]
    elif np.isfinite(event_tau) and event_tau <= params.T + event_tol:
        tau = min(event_tau, params.T)
        completed = False
        contract_status = ["OUT_OF_SCOPE"]
        numerical_status = "SUCCESS_EVENT"
        returned_interval = f"[0,{tau})"
        event_state = np.asarray(sol.sol(tau), dtype=float)
        guard_values = torus_derived(params, event_state[None, :])
        triggered = [
            name
            for name, times in zip(event_names, sol.t_events)
            if len(times) and abs(float(times[0]) - event_tau) <= event_tol
        ]
        tension_values = np.asarray(
            [
                guard_values["T_A"][0],
                guard_values["T_B"][0],
                guard_values["T_lower"][0],
            ],
            dtype=float,
        )
        # The zero certificate uses a run-input-derived force scale.  It must
        # not expand with the candidate root values themselves, otherwise a
        # nonzero tension could manufacture its own permissive tolerance.
        tension_scale = max(
            params.mass * params.g,
            np.finfo(float).tiny,
        )
        tension_zero_tolerance = 1024.0 * np.finfo(float).eps * tension_scale
        for name, value in zip(event_names[1:], tension_values):
            if abs(float(value)) <= tension_zero_tolerance:
                triggered.append(name)
        length_scale = max(
            params.s_A,
            params.s_B,
            params.lower_length,
            params.d,
            params.h,
            np.finfo(float).tiny,
        )
        if abs(float(guard_values["R"][0])) <= (
            1024.0 * np.finfo(float).eps * length_scale
        ):
            triggered.append("R_ZERO")
        # In the frozen torus equations both upper tensions are exact finite
        # multipliers of T_lower.  This is a model identity, unlike a generic
        # mixed-unit absolute-value threshold.
        if "T_LOWER_ZERO" in triggered:
            triggered.extend(("T_A_ZERO", "T_B_ZERO"))
        triggered = sorted(set(triggered))
        events = [{
            "kind": "physical_exit",
            "time": tau,
            "triggers": triggered,
            "state_left": event_state,
            "derived_left": {
                name: np.asarray(value)[0]
                for name, value in guard_values.items()
            },
            "guard_values": {name: float(value) for name, value in zip(event_names, [guard_values["R"][0], guard_values["T_A"][0], guard_values["T_B"][0], guard_values["T_lower"][0]])},
            "guard_zero_tolerances": {
                name: (
                    1024.0 * np.finfo(float).eps * length_scale
                    if name == "R_ZERO"
                    else tension_zero_tolerance
                )
                for name in triggered
            },
        }]
    else:
        tau = params.T
        completed = True
        contract_status = ["COMPLETED"]
        numerical_status = "SUCCESS_SINGLE_RUN"
        returned_interval = f"[0,{params.T}]"
        events = []

    time = _output_times(tau, output_dt, include_end=completed or not contract_status)
    states = np.asarray(sol.sol(time), dtype=float).T if time.size else np.empty((0, 4))
    derived = torus_derived(params, states) if time.size else {}
    diagnostics = _torus_run_diagnostics(
        params, time, derived, sol, solver_warnings
    )

    postrun_failure = (
        _torus_completed_sample_failure(params, time, states, derived)
        if completed
        else None
    )
    if postrun_failure is not None:
        candidate_diagnostics = diagnostics
        completed = False
        contract_status = []
        numerical_status = postrun_failure["numerical_status"]
        tau = float(postrun_failure["time"])
        returned_interval = (
            "candidate samples only; completed physical contract could not be "
            f"certified at or before {tau}"
        )
        events = [postrun_failure]
        failure_index = int(postrun_failure.get("sample_index", 0))
        time = time[:failure_index]
        states = states[:failure_index]
        derived = {
            name: np.asarray(value)[:failure_index]
            for name, value in derived.items()
        }
        diagnostics = _torus_run_diagnostics(
            params, time, derived, sol, solver_warnings
        )
        diagnostics["postrun_failure"] = postrun_failure
        diagnostics["candidate_full_diagnostics_at_detection"] = (
            candidate_diagnostics
        )

    def position_at(times):
        query_states = np.asarray(sol.sol(times), dtype=float).T
        return torus_derived(params, query_states)["r_m"]

    observations = (
        {
            "status": ["OBSERVATION_UNRESOLVED_DUE_TO_NUMERICS"],
            "errors": [
                {
                    "code": numerical_status,
                    "detected_at_sample": tau,
                }
            ],
        }
        if postrun_failure is not None and config.get("observation") is not None
        else evaluate_observations(
            config.get("observation"),
            position_at=position_at,
            interval_end=tau,
            completed=completed,
            e_z=params.e_z,
            event_time_tolerance=event_tol,
        )
    )
    return SimulationResult(
        model_id="FWD-TORUS-1.0",
        contract_status=contract_status,
        numerical_status=numerical_status,
        tau=tau,
        returned_interval=returned_interval,
        time=time,
        state={"X_torus": states},
        derived=derived,
        events=events,
        diagnostics=diagnostics,
        observations=observations,
        metadata={
            **identity,
            "integrator": method,
            "rtol": rtol,
            "effective_rtol": rtol,
            "atol": atol,
            "atol_angle": atol_angle,
            "atol_rate": atol_rate,
            "effective_atol_vector": {
                "angle": atol_angle,
                "rate": atol_rate,
            },
            "max_step": max_step,
            "event_cluster_tolerance": event_tol,
            "coordinate_note": "angles integrated on real representatives; no modulo during integration",
        },
    )


def _torus_run_diagnostics(
    params: TorusParameters,
    time: np.ndarray,
    derived: dict[str, Any],
    sol: Any,
    solver_warnings: list[dict[str, str]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    energy = np.asarray(derived.get("E_torus", np.empty(0)), dtype=float)
    energy_variation = (
        float(np.max(np.abs(energy - energy[0]))) if energy.size else 0.0
    )
    gravitational_scale = params.mass * params.g * params.lower_length
    energy_scale = max(
        gravitational_scale,
        energy_variation,
        np.finfo(float).tiny,
    )
    length_scale = max(
        params.s_A,
        params.s_B,
        params.lower_length,
        params.d,
        params.h,
        np.finfo(float).tiny,
    )
    tension_scale = max(
        params.mass * params.g,
        np.finfo(float).tiny,
    )
    guard_component_series = {
        "R_ZERO": np.asarray(derived.get("R", np.empty(0)), dtype=float),
        "T_A_ZERO": np.asarray(
            derived.get("T_A", np.empty(0)), dtype=float
        ),
        "T_B_ZERO": np.asarray(
            derived.get("T_B", np.empty(0)), dtype=float
        ),
        "T_LOWER_ZERO": np.asarray(
            derived.get("T_lower", np.empty(0)), dtype=float
        ),
    }
    return {
        "solver_message": sol.message,
        "nfev": int(sol.nfev),
        "njev": int(getattr(sol, "njev", 0)),
        "nlu": int(getattr(sol, "nlu", 0)),
        "energy_scale": float(energy_scale),
        "energy_scale_components": {
            "gravitational": float(gravitational_scale),
            "energy_variation": float(energy_variation),
        },
        "max_absolute_energy_drift": energy_variation if energy.size else None,
        "max_relative_energy_drift": (
            float(energy_variation / energy_scale) if energy.size else None
        ),
        "max_abs_torus_unsquared_residual": (
            float(np.max(np.abs(derived["torus_unsquared_residual"])))
            if time.size
            else None
        ),
        "max_abs_physical_branch_residual": (
            float(np.max(np.abs(derived["physical_branch_residual"])))
            if time.size
            else None
        ),
        "min_Q_T": float(np.min(derived["Q_T"])) if time.size else None,
        "sampled_guard_component_series": guard_component_series,
        "guard_component_scales": {
            "R_ZERO": float(length_scale),
            "T_A_ZERO": float(tension_scale),
            "T_B_ZERO": float(tension_scale),
            "T_LOWER_ZERO": float(tension_scale),
        },
        "refinement_qualification": "SINGLE_RUN_CANDIDATE",
        "solver_warnings": solver_warnings,
    }
def _torus_completed_sample_failure(
    params: TorusParameters,
    time: np.ndarray,
    states: np.ndarray,
    derived: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Fail closed on sampled evidence that a nominal completion is invalid.

    ``solve_ivp`` locates sign-changing roots, but a tangential contact can
    touch a zero guard without changing sign.  A completion is therefore
    certified only if every returned sample is finite, remains strictly away
    from the four physical guards at its own machine-scaled tolerance, and
    satisfies both unsquared torus identities to roundoff scale.
    """

    if not time.size or states.shape != (time.size, 4):
        return {
            "kind": "numerical_invariant_failure",
            "numerical_status": "INVARIANT_FAILURE",
            "time": 0.0,
            "reason": "missing or malformed completed state samples",
        }
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(states)):
        bad_rows = np.flatnonzero(~np.all(np.isfinite(states), axis=1))
        index = int(bad_rows[0]) if bad_rows.size else 0
        return {
            "kind": "numerical_nonfinite_state",
            "numerical_status": "NONFINITE_STATE",
            "time": float(time[index]),
            "sample_index": index,
        }
    required = {
        "R",
        "T_A",
        "T_B",
        "T_lower",
        "Q_T",
        "torus_unsquared_residual",
        "physical_branch_residual",
    }
    if not required.issubset(derived):
        return {
            "kind": "numerical_invariant_failure",
            "numerical_status": "INVARIANT_FAILURE",
            "time": 0.0,
            "reason": f"missing derived fields: {sorted(required - set(derived))}",
        }
    for name, value in derived.items():
        array = np.asarray(value)
        if array.dtype == object or not np.all(np.isfinite(array)):
            index = 0
            if array.ndim and array.shape[0] == time.size:
                rows = np.reshape(np.isfinite(array), (time.size, -1)).all(axis=1)
                bad_rows = np.flatnonzero(~rows)
                if bad_rows.size:
                    index = int(bad_rows[0])
            return {
                "kind": "numerical_nonfinite_state",
                "numerical_status": "NONFINITE_STATE",
                "time": float(time[index]),
                "sample_index": index,
                "field": name,
            }

    length_scale = max(
        params.s_A,
        params.s_B,
        params.lower_length,
        params.d,
        params.h,
    )
    eps = np.finfo(float).eps
    R = np.asarray(derived["R"], dtype=float)
    tensions = {
        name: np.asarray(derived[name], dtype=float)
        for name in ("T_A", "T_B", "T_lower")
    }
    guard_hits: list[tuple[int, str, float, float]] = []
    R_tolerance = 1024.0 * eps * length_scale
    for index in np.flatnonzero(R <= R_tolerance):
        guard_hits.append(
            (int(index), "R_ZERO", float(R[index]), float(R_tolerance))
        )
    force_reference = params.mass * params.g
    for name, values in tensions.items():
        tolerances = 1024.0 * eps * np.maximum(force_reference, np.abs(values))
        for index in np.flatnonzero(values <= tolerances):
            guard_hits.append(
                (
                    int(index),
                    f"{name.upper()}_ZERO",
                    float(values[index]),
                    float(tolerances[index]),
                )
            )
    if guard_hits:
        first_index = min(item[0] for item in guard_hits)
        hits = [item for item in guard_hits if item[0] == first_index]
        return {
            "kind": "numerical_event_unresolved",
            "numerical_status": "EVENT_UNRESOLVED",
            "time": float(time[first_index]),
            "sample_index": first_index,
            "triggers": sorted({item[1] for item in hits}),
            "sampled_guard_values": {item[1]: item[2] for item in hits},
            "guard_zero_tolerances": {item[1]: item[3] for item in hits},
        }

    squared_scale = max(length_scale * length_scale, np.finfo(float).tiny)
    residual_tolerance = 8192.0 * eps * squared_scale
    unsquared = np.abs(
        np.asarray(derived["torus_unsquared_residual"], dtype=float)
    )
    branch = np.abs(
        np.asarray(derived["physical_branch_residual"], dtype=float)
    )
    Q_T = np.asarray(derived["Q_T"], dtype=float)
    invalid = (
        (unsquared > residual_tolerance)
        | (branch > residual_tolerance)
        | (Q_T < -residual_tolerance)
    )
    indices = np.flatnonzero(invalid)
    if indices.size:
        index = int(indices[0])
        return {
            "kind": "numerical_invariant_failure",
            "numerical_status": "INVARIANT_FAILURE",
            "time": float(time[index]),
            "sample_index": index,
            "torus_unsquared_residual": float(unsquared[index]),
            "physical_branch_residual": float(branch[index]),
            "Q_T": float(Q_T[index]),
            "absolute_residual_tolerance": float(residual_tolerance),
        }
    return None


def _output_times(end: float, step: float, *, include_end: bool) -> np.ndarray:
    if end < 0:
        return np.empty(0)
    count = safe_uniform_sample_count(
        end,
        step,
        maximum_samples=MAX_UNIFORM_SAMPLES,
    )
    if count is None:
        raise ValueError("unsafe uniform output grid")
    values = step * np.arange(count)
    if include_end and (not values.size or values[-1] < end - 1e-13 * max(1.0, end)):
        values = np.append(values, end)
    if not include_end:
        values = values[values < end]
    return values


def _invalid_numerics(config, path, actual, expected, identity):
    return SimulationResult(
        model_id="FWD-TORUS-1.0",
        contract_status=[],
        numerical_status="INVALID_NUMERICAL_CONFIG",
        tau=0.0,
        returned_interval="empty",
        time=np.empty(0),
        events=[{"kind": "numerical_input", "failures": [ValidationIssue("NUMERICAL_CONFIG", path, actual, expected).as_dict()]}],
        metadata=identity,
    )


def _validate_torus_numerics(
    numerics: dict[str, Any]
) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
    issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
    reject_unknown_keys(
        numerics, TORUS_NUMERICAL_FIELDS, "numerics", issues
    )
    method = numerics.get("method", "DOP853")
    if method not in ("DOP853", "Radau"):
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "INTEGRATOR", "numerics.method", method, "DOP853 or Radau"
            )
        )
    defaults = {
        "rtol": 1e-9,
        "atol": 1e-11,
        "atol_angle": numerics.get("atol", 1e-11),
        "atol_rate": numerics.get("atol", 1e-11),
        "max_step": None,
        "output_dt": None,
        "event_cluster_tolerance": 1e-9,
    }
    for field, default in defaults.items():
        value = numerics.get(field, default)
        # T-dependent defaults are injected after physical validation.
        if value is None:
            continue
        if not is_finite_number(value) or float(value) <= 0.0:
            issues.append(
                ValidationIssue(
                    "NUMERICAL_CONFIG",
                    f"numerics.{field}",
                    value,
                    "positive finite real",
                )
            )
    rtol = numerics.get("rtol", 1e-9)
    if is_finite_number(rtol) and 0.0 < float(rtol) < MIN_SOLVER_RTOL:
        issues.append(
            ValidationIssue(
                "NUMERICAL_CONFIG",
                "numerics.rtol",
                rtol,
                f">= SciPy machine floor {MIN_SOLVER_RTOL:.17g}",
            )
        )
    return issues


def _invalid_numerical_issues(
    config: dict[str, Any],
    issues: list[ValidationIssue],
    identity: dict[str, Any],
) -> SimulationResult:
    return SimulationResult(
        model_id="FWD-TORUS-1.0",
        contract_status=[],
        numerical_status="INVALID_NUMERICAL_CONFIG",
        tau=0.0,
        returned_interval="empty",
        time=np.empty(0),
        events=[
            {
                "kind": "numerical_input",
                "failures": [issue.as_dict() for issue in issues],
            }
        ],
        metadata=identity,
    )
~~~~

~~~~python
"""Public orchestration API."""
~~~~
