~~~~python
    threshold_for_field = {
        "energy_balance_residual": "maximum_energy_balance_residual",
        "maximum_normalized_rate_defect": "maximum_normalized_rate_defect",
        "maximum_normalized_nonsmooth_increment_defect": (
            "maximum_normalized_nonsmooth_increment_defect"
        ),
        "maximum_normalized_signed_cumulative_defect": (
            "maximum_normalized_signed_cumulative_defect"
        ),
        "maximum_normalized_absolute_cumulative_defect": (
            "maximum_normalized_absolute_cumulative_defect"
        ),
    }
    values_by_field = {
        "energy_balance_residual": [
            float(contract["energy_balance_residual"]) for contract in contracts
        ],
        "maximum_normalized_rate_defect": [
            float(contract["dynamics_defect"]["maximum_normalized_rate_defect"])
            for contract in contracts
        ],
        "maximum_normalized_nonsmooth_increment_defect": [
            float(
                contract["dynamics_defect"][
                    "maximum_normalized_nonsmooth_increment_defect"
                ]
            )
            for contract in contracts
        ],
        "maximum_normalized_signed_cumulative_defect": [
            float(
                contract["dynamics_defect"][
                    "maximum_normalized_signed_cumulative_defect"
                ]
            )
            for contract in contracts
        ],
        "maximum_normalized_absolute_cumulative_defect": [
            float(
                contract["dynamics_defect"][
                    "maximum_normalized_absolute_cumulative_defect"
                ]
            )
            for contract in contracts
        ],
    }
    checks: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for metric_field in _ACCURACY_FIELDS:
        values = values_by_field[metric_field]
        threshold = float(physics_thresholds[threshold_for_field[metric_field]])
        floor = threshold * numerical_floor_fraction
        step_checks = [
            values[index + 1] <= values[index] / ratio_slack
            or values[index + 1] <= floor
            for index in range(2)
        ]
        checks[metric_field] = {
            "values_coarse_middle_fine": values,
            "finest_threshold": threshold,
            "metric_numerical_floor": floor,
            "coarse_to_middle_decreasing_or_at_floor": step_checks[0],
            "middle_to_fine_decreasing_or_at_floor": step_checks[1],
            "passed": all(step_checks) and values[-1] <= threshold,
        }
    return {
        "applicability": "time_refinement_only",
        "passed": all(item["passed"] for item in checks.values()),
        "metrics": checks,
    }


def _run_bundle(
    cfg: SimulationConfig,
    cache: dict[str, _RunBundle],
    package_root: Path,
) -> _RunBundle:
    validate_physical_config(cfg)
    config_hash = _canonical_config_hash(cfg)
    if config_hash in cache:
        return cache[config_hash]
    source_start = source_hash(package_root)
    runtime_identity_start = _runtime_identity()
    auxiliary_input_hash_start = _auxiliary_input_identity(cfg)
    model = HighFidelityModel(cfg)
    preparation = prepare_initial_state(cfg, model)
    result = simulate_high_fidelity(cfg, model=model, preparation=preparation)
    result_hash_start = canonical_hf_result_sha256(result)
    config_hash_end = _canonical_config_hash(cfg)
    auxiliary_input_hash_end = _auxiliary_input_identity(cfg)
    runtime_identity_end = _runtime_identity()
    source_end = source_hash(package_root)
    bundle = _RunBundle(
        config=cfg,
        config_hash=config_hash,
        model=model,
        preparation=preparation,
        result=result,
        source_start=source_start,
        source_end=source_end,
        config_hash_end=config_hash_end,
        runtime_identity_start=runtime_identity_start,
        runtime_identity_end=runtime_identity_end,
        auxiliary_input_hash_start=auxiliary_input_hash_start,
        auxiliary_input_hash_end=auxiliary_input_hash_end,
        result_hash_start=result_hash_start,
    )
    cache[config_hash] = bundle
    return bundle


def _write_candidate_artifacts(
    directory: Path,
    cache: dict[str, _RunBundle],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Persist every unique qualification trajectory with a local manifest."""

    if directory.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"HF candidate artifact directory already exists: {directory}")
    from ypendulum.io.hdf5 import write_hf_result

    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    records: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for config_hash, bundle in sorted(cache.items()):
        result_hash_at_write = canonical_hf_result_sha256(bundle.result)
        registered_result_hash = bundle.result_hash_start or result_hash_at_write
        candidate = directory / f"candidate_{config_hash[:16]}"
        candidate.mkdir()
        resolved_path = candidate / "config_resolved.json"
        resolved_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                resolved_config_dict(bundle.config),
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
                ensure_ascii=False,
                allow_nan=False,
            )
            + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        result_path = candidate / "result.h5"
        write_hf_result(result_path, bundle.result, bundle.model)
        identity = {
            "schema_version": "YPS-HF-CANDIDATE-IDENTITY-1.0",
            "model_id": bundle.result.model_id,
            "config_sha256": config_hash,
            "canonical_resolved_config_sha256_start": config_hash,
            "canonical_resolved_config_sha256_end": bundle.config_hash_end,
            "resolved_config_stable_during_run": (
                bundle.config_hash_end == config_hash
            ),
            "source_hash_start_sha256": bundle.source_start,
            "source_hash_end_sha256": bundle.source_end,
            "source_stable_during_run": bundle.source_start == bundle.source_end,
            "runtime_identity_start": bundle.runtime_identity_start,
            "runtime_identity_end": bundle.runtime_identity_end,
            "runtime_stable_during_run": (
                bundle.runtime_identity_start == bundle.runtime_identity_end
            ),
            "auxiliary_input_identity_start": bundle.auxiliary_input_hash_start,
            "auxiliary_input_identity_end": bundle.auxiliary_input_hash_end,
            "auxiliary_inputs_stable_during_run": (
                bundle.auxiliary_input_hash_start
                == bundle.auxiliary_input_hash_end
            ),
            "canonical_result_sha256_registered": registered_result_hash,
            "canonical_result_sha256_at_artifact_write": result_hash_at_write,
            "canonical_result_stable_before_artifact_write": (
                registered_result_hash == result_hash_at_write
            ),
            "controlled_physics_limit": bool(
                getattr(bundle.config.high_fidelity, "controlled_limit_study", False)
            ),
            "physical_status": bundle.result.physical_status,
            "numerical_status": bundle.result.numerical_status,
            "solver_method": bundle.config.solver.method,
            "elements": {
                name: getattr(bundle.config.cables, name).elements
                for name in ("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower")
            },
            "output_sample_count": int(bundle.result.time.size),
            "accepted_step_count": int(bundle.result.integration_time.size - 1),
            "units": "SI",
        }
        identity_path = candidate / "identity.json"
        identity_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                identity,
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
                ensure_ascii=False,
                allow_nan=False,
            )
            + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        files = []
        for path in (resolved_path, result_path, identity_path):
            files.append(
                {
                    "path": path.name,
                    "sha256": _sha256_file(path),
                    "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                }
            )
        manifest_path = candidate / "candidate_manifest.json"
        manifest_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "schema_version": "YPS-HF-CANDIDATE-MANIFEST-1.0",
                    "config_sha256": config_hash,
                    "files": files,
                },
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
                ensure_ascii=False,
                allow_nan=False,
            )
            + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        records[config_hash] = {
            "relative_directory": candidate.name,
            "candidate_manifest_sha256": _sha256_file(manifest_path),
            "candidate_manifest_bytes": manifest_path.stat().st_size,
        }
    return records


def _space_configs(base: SimulationConfig) -> list[SimulationConfig]:
    finest = [
        base.cables.upper_A.elements,
        base.cables.upper_B.elements,
        base.cables.lower.elements,
    ]
    if any(value % 4 for value in finest):
        raise ValueError("HF production element counts must be divisible by four.")
    levels: list[SimulationConfig] = []
    for divisor in (4, 2, 1):
        candidate = base.model_copy(deep=True)
        for name, value in zip(("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower"), finest, strict=True):
            getattr(candidate.cables, name).elements = value // divisor
        candidate.solver.allow_subminimum_mesh = divisor != 1
        levels.append(candidate)
    return levels


def _time_configs(base: SimulationConfig) -> list[SimulationConfig]:
    required = {
        "rtol": base.solver.rtol,
        "position_atol": base.solver.position_atol,
        "velocity_atol": base.solver.velocity_atol,
        "quaternion_atol": base.solver.quaternion_atol,
        "angular_velocity_atol": base.solver.angular_velocity_atol,
    }
    if any(value is None for value in required.values()) or base.solver.max_step == "auto":
        raise ValueError("HF convergence requires explicit finest tolerances and max_step.")
    levels: list[SimulationConfig] = []
    for tolerance_factor, step_factor in ((16.0, 4.0), (4.0, 2.0), (1.0, 1.0)):
        candidate = base.model_copy(deep=True)
        candidate.solver.rtol = float(base.solver.rtol) * tolerance_factor  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        candidate.solver.position_atol = _quantity_scaled(
            base.solver.position_atol, tolerance_factor, "m"
        )
        candidate.solver.velocity_atol = _quantity_scaled(
            base.solver.velocity_atol, tolerance_factor, "m/s"
        )
        candidate.solver.quaternion_atol = (
            float(base.solver.quaternion_atol) * tolerance_factor  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )
        candidate.solver.angular_velocity_atol = _quantity_scaled(
            base.solver.angular_velocity_atol, tolerance_factor, "rad/s"
        )
        candidate.solver.max_step = _quantity_scaled(
            base.solver.max_step, step_factor, "s"
        )
        levels.append(candidate)
    return levels


def _cross_solver_config(
    base: SimulationConfig, spec: dict[str, Any]
) -> SimulationConfig:
    """Build an alternate-integrator candidate at a certified error budget.

    Equal relative tolerances do not imply equal local defects for different
    algorithms.  The factors are frozen before the study, applied to every
    scalar/vector tolerance, and persisted through the candidate config hash.
    """

    candidate = base.model_copy(deep=True)
    candidate.solver.method = "BDF" if base.solver.method == "Radau" else "Radau"
    factor = float(spec["cross_solver_tolerance_factors"][candidate.solver.method])
    required = (
        base.solver.rtol,
        base.solver.position_atol,
        base.solver.velocity_atol,
        base.solver.quaternion_atol,
        base.solver.angular_velocity_atol,
    )
    if any(value is None for value in required):
        raise ValueError("HF cross-solver validation requires explicit tolerances.")
    candidate.solver.rtol = float(base.solver.rtol) * factor  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    candidate.solver.position_atol = _quantity_scaled(
        base.solver.position_atol, factor, "m"
    )
    candidate.solver.velocity_atol = _quantity_scaled(
        base.solver.velocity_atol, factor, "m/s"
    )
    candidate.solver.quaternion_atol = (
        float(base.solver.quaternion_atol) * factor  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    )
    candidate.solver.angular_velocity_atol = _quantity_scaled(
        base.solver.angular_velocity_atol, factor, "rad/s"
    )
    return candidate


def run_hf_validation(
    base_config: SimulationConfig | str | Path | dict[str, Any],
    validation_spec: str | Path | dict[str, Any],
    *,
    artifact_directory: str | Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run the frozen space/time/two-integrator HF qualification matrix."""

    base_input_path = (
        Path(base_config).expanduser().resolve()
        if isinstance(base_config, (str, Path))
        else None
    )
    spec_input_path = (
        Path(validation_spec).expanduser().resolve()
        if isinstance(validation_spec, (str, Path))
        else None
    )
    input_file_hash_start = {
        "base_config": (
            _sha256_file(base_input_path) if base_input_path is not None else None
        ),
        "validation_spec": (
            _sha256_file(spec_input_path) if spec_input_path is not None else None
        ),
    }
    base = (
        base_config
        if isinstance(base_config, SimulationConfig)
        else load_config(base_config)
    )
    if isinstance(validation_spec, (str, Path)):
        raw_spec = load_unique_yaml(validation_spec)
    else:
        raw_spec = validation_spec
    spec = _freeze_and_validate_spec(raw_spec)
    validate_physical_config(base)
    if base.run.mode != "high_fidelity":
        raise ValueError("HF validation requires run.mode=high_fidelity.")
    if base.solver.method not in {"Radau", "BDF"}:
        raise ValueError("HF validation requires Radau or BDF as the production method.")
    certification_target = _validation_target_applicability(base, spec)
    if not certification_target["passed"]:
        raise ValueError(
            "HF validation specification is not applicable to the resolved "
            f"production target: {certification_target['failure_reason']}"
        )
    base_hash = _canonical_config_hash(base)
    spec_hash = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(
            spec,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
            ensure_ascii=False,
            allow_nan=False,
        ).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()
    package_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    study_source_start = source_hash(package_root)
    runtime_identity_start = _runtime_identity()
    cache: dict[str, _RunBundle] = {}
    started = perf_counter()

    study_reports: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for study_name, candidates in (
        ("space", _space_configs(base)),
        ("time", _time_configs(base)),
    ):
        bundles = [_run_bundle(candidate, cache, package_root) for candidate in candidates]
        level_contracts = [
            _level_contract(
                bundle,
                spec["physics_checks"],
                apply_accuracy=index == len(bundles) - 1,
            )
            for index, bundle in enumerate(bundles)
        ]
        comparisons = [
            _compare(bundles[0], bundles[1], int(spec["material_comparison_points"])),
            _compare(bundles[1], bundles[2], int(spec["material_comparison_points"])),
        ]
        cauchy = _cauchy_gate(
            comparisons,
            spec["thresholds"][study_name],
            ratio_slack=float(spec["cauchy_ratio_slack"]),
            numerical_floor_fraction=float(spec["numerical_floor_fraction"]),
        )
        events = _event_stability(
            bundles, float(spec["maximum_event_time_spread_s"])
        )
        accuracy_trend = (
            _accuracy_trend_gate(
                level_contracts,
                spec["physics_checks"],
                ratio_slack=float(spec["cauchy_ratio_slack"]),
                numerical_floor_fraction=float(spec["numerical_floor_fraction"]),
            )
            if study_name == "time"
            else {
                "applicability": "not_applicable_to_space_refinement",
                "passed": True,
                "metrics": {},
            }
        )
        study_reports[study_name] = {
            "passed": all(level["passed"] for level in level_contracts)
            and cauchy["passed"]
            and events["passed"]
            and accuracy_trend["passed"],
            "levels": [
                {
                    "config_sha256": bundle.config_hash,
                    "elements": {
                        name: getattr(bundle.config.cables, name).elements
                        for name in ("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower")
                    },
                    "rtol": bundle.config.solver.rtol,
                    "max_step_s": float(
                        to_si(bundle.config.solver.max_step, default_unit="s")
                    ),
                    "runtime_seconds": bundle.result.diagnostics["runtime_seconds"],
                    "contract": contract,
                }
                for bundle, contract in zip(bundles, level_contracts, strict=True)
            ],
            "comparisons": comparisons,
            "cauchy": cauchy,
            "events": events,
            "accuracy_trend": accuracy_trend,
        }

    fine_bundle = _run_bundle(base, cache, package_root)
    cross_cfg = _cross_solver_config(base, spec)
    cross_bundle = _run_bundle(cross_cfg, cache, package_root)
    cross_comparison = _compare(
        fine_bundle, cross_bundle, int(spec["material_comparison_points"])
    )
    cross_checks = {
        metric: float(cross_comparison[metric]) <= float(threshold)
        for metric, threshold in spec["thresholds"]["cross_solver"].items()
    }
    cross_contracts = [
        _level_contract(bundle, spec["physics_checks"], apply_accuracy=True)
        for bundle in (fine_bundle, cross_bundle)
    ]
    cross_report = {
        "passed": all(cross_checks.values())
        and all(contract["passed"] for contract in cross_contracts),
        "methods": [base.solver.method, cross_cfg.solver.method],
        "alternate_tolerance_factor": float(
            spec["cross_solver_tolerance_factors"][cross_cfg.solver.method]
        ),
        "config_sha256": [fine_bundle.config_hash, cross_bundle.config_hash],
        "comparison": cross_comparison,
        "threshold_checks": cross_checks,
        "contracts": cross_contracts,
    }
    candidate_artifacts = (
        _write_candidate_artifacts(Path(artifact_directory), cache)
        if artifact_directory is not None
        else {}
    )
    study_source_end = source_hash(package_root)
    runtime_identity_end = _runtime_identity()
    input_file_hash_end = {
        "base_config": (
            _sha256_file(base_input_path) if base_input_path is not None else None
        ),
        "validation_spec": (
            _sha256_file(spec_input_path) if spec_input_path is not None else None
        ),
    }
    base_is_finest = (
        study_reports["space"]["levels"][-1]["config_sha256"] == base_hash
        and study_reports["time"]["levels"][-1]["config_sha256"] == base_hash
    )
    passed = (
        certification_target["passed"]
        and study_source_start == study_source_end
        and runtime_identity_start == runtime_identity_end
        and input_file_hash_start == input_file_hash_end
        and base_is_finest
        and all(report["passed"] for report in study_reports.values())
        and cross_report["passed"]
    )
    return {
        "schema_version": "YPS-HF-VALIDATION-REPORT-1.0",
        "qualification": (
            "HF_REFINEMENT_SUPPORTED" if passed else "HF_CONVERGENCE_NOT_DEMONSTRATED"
        ),
        "passed": passed,
        "model_id": HighFidelityModel.model_id,
        "base_config_sha256": base_hash,
        "validation_spec_sha256": spec_hash,
        "certification_target": certification_target,
        "base_config_is_finest_level": base_is_finest,
        "source_hash_start_sha256": study_source_start,
        "source_hash_end_sha256": study_source_end,
        "source_stable_during_study": study_source_start == study_source_end,
        "runtime_identity_start": runtime_identity_start,
        "runtime_identity_end": runtime_identity_end,
        "runtime_stable_during_study": runtime_identity_start
        == runtime_identity_end,
        "input_file_hash_start": input_file_hash_start,
        "input_file_hash_end": input_file_hash_end,
        "input_files_stable_during_study": input_file_hash_start
        == input_file_hash_end,
        "unique_run_count": len(cache),
        "wall_time_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "studies": study_reports,
        "cross_solver": cross_report,
        "candidate_artifacts": candidate_artifacts,
        "validation_spec": spec,
    }
~~~~

# Layer 3 source: src/ypendulum/hf/independence.py

~~~~python
"""Controlled-limit evidence that the HF backend contains additional physics."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from numbers import Integral, Real
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from ypendulum.config import SimulationConfig, load_config, load_unique_yaml
from ypendulum.io.provenance import source_hash

from .model import HighFidelityModel
from .validation import (
    _COMPARISON_METRICS,
    _canonical_config_hash,
    _compare,
    _cross_solver_config,
    _freeze_and_validate_spec,
    _json_safe_finite,
    _level_contract,
    _run_bundle,
    _runtime_identity,
    _sha256_file,
    _validation_target_applicability,
    _write_candidate_artifacts,
)

_LOCKED_ALPHA_SCALES = [1.0, 1.0e-2, 1.0e-4, 1.0e-6]


def _positive_real(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Real):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive finite real number.")
    scalar = float(value)
    if not np.isfinite(scalar) or scalar <= 0.0:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive finite real number.")
    return scalar


def _freeze_independence_spec(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    required = {
        "schema_version",
        "limit_scales",
        "cauchy_ratio_slack",
        "cross_solver_floor_multiplier",
        "separation_factor",
        "minimum_separation_metric_count",
        "minimum_finite_to_limit",
        "minimum_peak_bending_energy_J",
        "minimum_peak_angular_velocity_rad_s",
        "material_comparison_points",
    }
    allowed = required | {"metadata"}
    if (
        not isinstance(raw, dict)
        or not _json_safe_finite(raw)
        or set(raw) - allowed
        or required - set(raw)
    ):
        raise ValueError("HF independence specification fields do not match the frozen schema.")
    try:
        spec = json.loads(
            json.dumps(
                raw,
                sort_keys=True,
                separators=(",", ":"),
                ensure_ascii=False,
                allow_nan=False,
            )
        )
    except (OverflowError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("HF independence specification is not finite canonical JSON.") from exc
    if spec["schema_version"] != "YPS-HF-INDEPENDENCE-1.0":
        raise ValueError("Invalid HF independence specification schema.")
    scales = spec["limit_scales"]
    if not isinstance(scales, list):
        raise ValueError("limit_scales must be the locked alpha scale list.")
    scale_values = [_positive_real(value, "limit_scales[]") for value in scales]
    if scale_values != _LOCKED_ALPHA_SCALES:
        raise ValueError(
            "limit_scales must equal the locked list [1, 1e-2, 1e-4, 1e-6]."
        )
    ratio_slack = _positive_real(spec["cauchy_ratio_slack"], "cauchy_ratio_slack")
    if ratio_slack < 1.0:
        raise ValueError("cauchy_ratio_slack must be at least one.")
    floor_multiplier = _positive_real(
        spec["cross_solver_floor_multiplier"], "cross_solver_floor_multiplier"
    )
    if floor_multiplier < 1.0:
        raise ValueError("cross_solver_floor_multiplier must be at least one.")
    separation_factor = _positive_real(spec["separation_factor"], "separation_factor")
    if separation_factor < 1.0:
        raise ValueError("separation_factor must be at least one.")
    count = spec["minimum_separation_metric_count"]
    if isinstance(count, bool) or not isinstance(count, Integral) or count < 1:
        raise ValueError("minimum_separation_metric_count must be a positive integer.")
    points = spec["material_comparison_points"]
    if isinstance(points, bool) or not isinstance(points, Integral) or not 5 <= points <= 4097:
        raise ValueError("material_comparison_points must be an integer in [5,4097].")
    selected = spec["minimum_finite_to_limit"]
    if not isinstance(selected, dict) or not selected:
        raise ValueError("minimum_finite_to_limit must contain selected canonical metrics.")
    if not set(selected).issubset(_COMPARISON_METRICS):
        raise ValueError("minimum_finite_to_limit contains a non-canonical metric.")
    if count > len(selected):
        raise ValueError("minimum_separation_metric_count exceeds selected metrics.")
    for metric, value in selected.items():
        _positive_real(value, f"minimum_finite_to_limit.{metric}")
    _positive_real(
        spec["minimum_peak_bending_energy_J"], "minimum_peak_bending_energy_J"
    )
    _positive_real(
        spec["minimum_peak_angular_velocity_rad_s"],
        "minimum_peak_angular_velocity_rad_s",
    )
    return spec


def _input_path(value: Any) -> Path | None:
    return Path(value).expanduser().resolve() if isinstance(value, (str, Path)) else None


def run_hf_independence_study(
    base_config: SimulationConfig | str | Path | dict[str, Any],
    validation_spec: str | Path | dict[str, Any],
    independence_spec: str | Path | dict[str, Any],
    *,
    artifact_directory: str | Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run a finite-physics versus controlled-zero-limit separation study."""

    base_path = _input_path(base_config)
    validation_path = _input_path(validation_spec)
    independence_path = _input_path(independence_spec)
    input_start = {
        "base_config": _sha256_file(base_path) if base_path else None,
        "validation_spec": _sha256_file(validation_path) if validation_path else None,
        "independence_spec": (
            _sha256_file(independence_path) if independence_path else None
        ),
    }
    base = base_config if isinstance(base_config, SimulationConfig) else load_config(base_config)
    raw_validation = (
        load_unique_yaml(validation_spec)
        if isinstance(validation_spec, (str, Path))
        else validation_spec
    )
    physics_spec = _freeze_and_validate_spec(raw_validation)
    raw_independence = (
        load_unique_yaml(independence_spec)
        if isinstance(independence_spec, (str, Path))
        else independence_spec
    )
    spec = _freeze_independence_spec(raw_independence)
    if base.run.mode != "high_fidelity":
        raise ValueError("HF independence study requires run.mode=high_fidelity.")
    if base.solver.method not in {"Radau", "BDF"}:
        raise ValueError("HF independence study requires Radau or BDF as the base solver.")
    certification_target = _validation_target_applicability(base, physics_spec)
    if not certification_target["passed"]:
        raise ValueError(
            "HF independence validation specification is not applicable to the "
            f"resolved production target: {certification_target['failure_reason']}"
        )
    if (
        base.high_fidelity.bending_stiffness_scale != 1.0
        or base.high_fidelity.compression_regularization_scale != 1.0
        or base.high_fidelity.bob_attachment_radius_fraction != 1.0
        or base.high_fidelity.bob_contact_radius_fraction != 1.0
        or base.high_fidelity.controlled_limit_study
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "The finite-physics base must use unit bending, compression, attachment "
            "and contact scales with controlled_limit_study=false."
        )

    package_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    source_start = source_hash(package_root)
    runtime_start = _runtime_identity()
    cache = {}
    started = perf_counter()
    full = _run_bundle(base, cache, package_root)
    limit_bundles = []
    for scale in spec["limit_scales"][1:]:
        candidate = base.model_copy(deep=True)
        candidate.high_fidelity.bending_stiffness_scale = float(scale)
        candidate.high_fidelity.compression_regularization_scale = float(scale)
        candidate.high_fidelity.bob_attachment_radius_fraction = float(scale)
        candidate.high_fidelity.bob_contact_radius_fraction = float(scale)
        candidate.high_fidelity.controlled_limit_study = True
        candidate.run.claim_level = "OUT_OF_SCOPE"
        limit_bundles.append(_run_bundle(candidate, cache, package_root))
    alternate = _cross_solver_config(base, physics_spec)
    cross = _run_bundle(alternate, cache, package_root)

    contracts = {
        bundle.config_hash: _level_contract(
            bundle, physics_spec["physics_checks"], apply_accuracy=True
        )
        for bundle in [full, *limit_bundles, cross]
    }
    material_points = int(spec["material_comparison_points"])
    alpha_bundles = [full, *limit_bundles]
    adjacent = [
        _compare(left, right, material_points)
        for left, right in zip(alpha_bundles, alpha_bundles[1:], strict=True)
    ]
    full_to_limit = _compare(full, limit_bundles[-1], material_points)
    cross_solver = _compare(full, cross, material_points)
    ratio = float(spec["cauchy_ratio_slack"])
    floor_multiplier = float(spec["cross_solver_floor_multiplier"])
    contraction_checks = {}
    for metric in _COMPARISON_METRICS:
        values = [float(comparison[metric]) for comparison in adjacent]
        floor = floor_multiplier * float(cross_solver[metric])
        steps = [
            values[index + 1] <= values[index] / ratio
            or values[index + 1] <= floor
            for index in range(len(values) - 1)
        ]
        contraction_checks[metric] = {
            "alpha_scales": spec["limit_scales"],
            "successive_alpha_differences": values,
            "cross_solver_floor": floor,
            "step_checks": steps,
            "passed": all(steps),
        }
    separation_checks = {}
    for metric, minimum in spec["minimum_finite_to_limit"].items():
        difference = float(full_to_limit[metric])
        numerical = float(cross_solver[metric])
        required = max(float(minimum), float(spec["separation_factor"]) * numerical)
        separation_checks[metric] = {
            "finite_to_limit_difference": difference,
            "full_cross_solver_difference": numerical,
            "required_difference": required,
            "passed": difference > required,
        }
    separation_count = sum(item["passed"] for item in separation_checks.values())
    peak_bending = float(np.max(full.result.energy["elastic_bending"]))
    peak_angular_velocity = float(
        np.max(np.linalg.norm(full.result.bob_angular_velocity, axis=1))
    )
    physical_evidence = {
        "peak_bending_energy_J": peak_bending,
        "peak_bending_energy_passed": peak_bending
        >= float(spec["minimum_peak_bending_energy_J"]),
        "peak_bob_angular_velocity_rad_s": peak_angular_velocity,
        "peak_bob_angular_velocity_passed": peak_angular_velocity
        >= float(spec["minimum_peak_angular_velocity_rad_s"]),
    }
    artifacts = (
        _write_candidate_artifacts(Path(artifact_directory), cache)
        if artifact_directory is not None
        else {}
    )
    source_end = source_hash(package_root)
    runtime_end = _runtime_identity()
    input_end = {
        "base_config": _sha256_file(base_path) if base_path else None,
        "validation_spec": _sha256_file(validation_path) if validation_path else None,
        "independence_spec": (
            _sha256_file(independence_path) if independence_path else None
        ),
    }
    passed = (
        certification_target["passed"]
        and source_start == source_end
        and runtime_start == runtime_end
        and input_start == input_end
        and all(contract["passed"] for contract in contracts.values())
        and all(item["passed"] for item in contraction_checks.values())
        and separation_count >= int(spec["minimum_separation_metric_count"])
        and all(
            physical_evidence[key]
            for key in (
                "peak_bending_energy_passed",
                "peak_bob_angular_velocity_passed",
            )
        )
    )
    spec_hash = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(spec, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    ).hexdigest()
    return {
        "schema_version": "YPS-HF-INDEPENDENCE-REPORT-1.0",
        "qualification": (
            "HF_INDEPENDENCE_SUPPORTED"
            if passed
            else "HF_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DEMONSTRATED"
        ),
        "passed": passed,
        "model_id": HighFidelityModel.model_id,
        "base_config_sha256": _canonical_config_hash(base),
        "validation_spec_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(
                physics_spec,
                sort_keys=True,
                separators=(",", ":"),
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ).encode()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "certification_target": certification_target,
        "independence_spec_sha256": spec_hash,
        "source_hash_start_sha256": source_start,
        "source_hash_end_sha256": source_end,
        "source_stable_during_study": source_start == source_end,
        "runtime_identity_start": runtime_start,
        "runtime_identity_end": runtime_end,
        "runtime_stable_during_study": runtime_start == runtime_end,
        "input_file_hash_start": input_start,
        "input_file_hash_end": input_end,
        "input_files_stable_during_study": input_start == input_end,
        "wall_time_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "unique_run_count": len(cache),
        "finite_config_sha256": full.config_hash,
        "limit_scales": spec["limit_scales"],
        "alpha_candidate_configs": [
            {
                "alpha": float(scale),
                "config_sha256": bundle.config_hash,
                "controlled_limit_study": bool(
                    bundle.config.high_fidelity.controlled_limit_study
                ),
                "claim_level": bundle.config.run.claim_level,
            }
            for scale, bundle in zip(
                spec["limit_scales"], alpha_bundles, strict=True
            )
        ],
        "jointly_scaled_parameters": [
            "bending_stiffness_scale",
            "compression_regularization_scale",
            "bob_attachment_radius_fraction",
            "bob_contact_radius_fraction",
        ],
        "limit_config_sha256": [bundle.config_hash for bundle in limit_bundles],
        "cross_solver_config_sha256": cross.config_hash,
        "contracts": contracts,
        "limit_contraction": contraction_checks,
        "finite_to_limit": full_to_limit,
        "full_cross_solver": cross_solver,
        "separation_checks": separation_checks,
        "separation_metric_pass_count": separation_count,
        "physical_evidence": physical_evidence,
        "candidate_artifacts": artifacts,
        "independence_spec": spec,
    }
~~~~

# Layer 3 source: src/ypendulum/analysis/diagnostics.py

~~~~python
"""Scale analysis, scope checks and scientific-claim readiness.

The diagnostics in this module are deliberately conservative.  They do not
replace a convergence study or an experimental validation; they identify when
an apparently precise run cannot support the requested observable or claim.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections import Counter
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from ypendulum.config.models import SimulationConfig
from ypendulum.config.units import as_vector3, source_of, to_si
from ypendulum.geometry import reduced_geometry_from_loaded_state
from ypendulum.models.full_cable import FullCableModel
from ypendulum.models.state import SimulationResult, StaticEquilibrium


_INDEPENDENT_SOURCES = {
    "measured",
    "calibrated_independent",
    "independent_test",
    "datasheet",
    "literature_prior",
    "standard",
    "balance",
    "caliper",
}
_SUSPECT_SOURCES = {None, "assumed", "fitted_target"}
_CLAIM_ORDER = {
    "DERIVED": 0,
    "VERIFIED": 1,
    "CALIBRATED": 2,
    "VALIDATED": 3,
    "PREDICTIVE": 4,
    "OUT_OF_SCOPE": -1,
}


def _quantity_source_rows(cfg: SimulationConfig) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return the physically consequential scalar/vector inputs and provenance."""

    rows: list[tuple[str, Any, bool, bool]] = [
        ("environment.gravity", cfg.environment.gravity, True, True),
        ("environment.air_density", cfg.environment.air_density, False, False),
        ("environment.air_velocity", cfg.environment.air_velocity, False, False),
        ("supports.A.position", cfg.supports.A.position, True, True),
        ("supports.B.position", cfg.supports.B.position, True, True),
        ("junction.mass", cfg.junction.mass, True, True),
        ("junction.drag_linear", cfg.junction.drag_linear, False, False),
        ("bob.mass", cfg.bob.mass, True, True),
        ("bob.radius", cfg.bob.radius, bool(cfg.bob.drag.enabled or cfg.bob.buoyancy), True),
        ("bob.drag.cd", cfg.bob.drag.cd, bool(cfg.bob.drag.enabled), False),
        (
            "bob.drag.linear_coefficient",
            cfg.bob.drag.linear_coefficient,
            bool(cfg.bob.drag.enabled),
            False,
        ),
    ]
    for name in ("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower"):
        cable = getattr(cfg.cables, name)
        rows.extend(
            [
                (f"cables.{name}.rest_length", cable.rest_length, True, True),
                (f"cables.{name}.diameter", cable.diameter, True, True),
                (f"cables.{name}.density", cable.density, True, True),
                (f"cables.{name}.young_modulus", cable.young_modulus, True, True),
                (
                    f"cables.{name}.axial_viscosity",
                    cable.axial_viscosity,
                    bool(float(to_si(cable.axial_viscosity, default_unit="Pa*s")) > 0.0),
                    False,
                ),
            ]
        )
        if cable.drag_enabled:
            # drag_cd_normal is a bare dimensionless scalar in the frozen schema.
            rows.append((f"cables.{name}.drag_cd_normal", None, True, False))
    if cfg.observer.type == "pinhole" and cfg.observer.camera is not None:
        camera = cfg.observer.camera
        rows.extend(
            [
                ("observer.camera.intrinsic_matrix", None, True, False),
                ("observer.camera.rotation_world_to_camera", None, True, False),
                (
                    "observer.camera.translation_world_to_camera",
                    camera.translation_world_to_camera,
                    True,
                    False,
                ),
                ("observer.camera.frame_rate", camera.frame_rate, True, False),
                ("observer.camera.exposure_time", camera.exposure_time, True, False),
            ]
        )
    return [
        {
            "parameter": name,
            "source": source_of(value),
            "active": active,
            "critical_for_low_frequency": critical,
        }
        for name, value, active, critical in rows
    ]


def parameter_provenance_audit(cfg: SimulationConfig) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows = _quantity_source_rows(cfg)
    active = [row for row in rows if row["active"]]
    counts = Counter("missing" if row["source"] is None else row["source"] for row in active)
    missing = [row["parameter"] for row in active if row["source"] is None]
    assumed = [row["parameter"] for row in active if row["source"] == "assumed"]
    fitted_target = [row["parameter"] for row in active if row["source"] == "fitted_target"]
    critical_suspect = [
        row["parameter"]
        for row in active
        if row["critical_for_low_frequency"] and row["source"] in _SUSPECT_SOURCES
    ]
    independently_sourced = [
        row["parameter"] for row in active if row["source"] in _INDEPENDENT_SOURCES
    ]
    return {
        "active_parameter_count": len(active),
        "source_counts": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
        "missing_source": missing,
        "assumed": assumed,
        "fitted_target": fitted_target,
        "critical_suspect": critical_suspect,
        "independently_sourced": independently_sourced,
        "rows": active,
    }


def _effective_step(cfg: SimulationConfig, model: FullCableModel) -> float:
    times = model.characteristic_times()
    output_dt = float(to_si(cfg.solver.output_dt, default_unit="s"))
    step = times["pendulum_period_estimate"] / 200.0
    if cfg.solver.resolve_longitudinal_waves:
        step = min(step, times["minimum_element_wave_crossing"] / 20.0)
    if cfg.solver.max_step != "auto":
        step = float(to_si(cfg.solver.max_step, default_unit="s"))
    return min(step, output_dt)


def _initial_amplitude(cfg: SimulationConfig) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, str]:
    if cfg.initial_condition.type == "reduced_angles_release":
        phi = abs(float(to_si(cfg.initial_condition.phi, default_unit="rad")))
        theta = abs(float(to_si(cfg.initial_condition.theta, default_unit="rad")))
        return phi, theta, "configured_reduced_angles"
    if cfg.initial_condition.type == "static_equilibrium":
        return 0.0, 0.0, "static_equilibrium"
    return None, None, f"unknown_for_{cfg.initial_condition.type}"


def _classify(value: float | None, epsilon_required: float, *, structural: bool = False) -> str:
    if structural:
        return "structural_required"
    if value is None or not np.isfinite(value):
        return "unknown"
    if value >= 3.0 * epsilon_required:
        return "retain"
    if value >= 0.3 * epsilon_required:
        return "borderline"
    return "negligible"


def _claim_readiness(
    cfg: SimulationConfig,
    provenance: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    numerical_warnings: list[str],
    scope_findings: list[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    requested = cfg.run.claim_level
    reasons: list[str] = []
    cap = "PREDICTIVE"
    if scope_findings:
        cap = "OUT_OF_SCOPE"
        reasons.extend(scope_findings)
    else:
        if provenance["critical_suspect"]:
            cap = "VERIFIED"
            reasons.append(
                "Critical geometry/mass/material parameters lack independent provenance: "
                + ", ".join(provenance["critical_suspect"])
            )
        elif provenance["assumed"] or provenance["fitted_target"] or provenance["missing_source"]:
            cap = "CALIBRATED"
            reasons.append(
                "Some active parameters are missing, assumed, or fitted on the target run."
            )
        if not cfg.run.validation_manifest and _CLAIM_ORDER[cap] > _CLAIM_ORDER["CALIBRATED"]:
            cap = "CALIBRATED"
            reasons.append("No frozen validation manifest is attached.")
        if cfg.solver.allow_subminimum_mesh and _CLAIM_ORDER[cap] > _CLAIM_ORDER["VERIFIED"]:
            cap = "VERIFIED"
            reasons.append("Subminimum H1 mesh is enabled.")
        if numerical_warnings and _CLAIM_ORDER[cap] > _CLAIM_ORDER["VERIFIED"]:
            cap = "VERIFIED"
            reasons.append("Numerical-observable resolution warnings remain unresolved.")

    if cap == "OUT_OF_SCOPE":
        requested_supported = requested == "OUT_OF_SCOPE"
    elif requested == "OUT_OF_SCOPE":
        requested_supported = False
        reasons.append("Configuration is not automatically identified as out of scope.")
    else:
        requested_supported = _CLAIM_ORDER[requested] <= _CLAIM_ORDER[cap]
        if not requested_supported:
            reasons.append(f"Requested {requested} exceeds configuration cap {cap}.")
    return {
        "requested_claim": requested,
        "configuration_claim_cap": cap,
        "requested_claim_supported": requested_supported,
        "reasons": reasons or ["No configuration-level blocker identified."],
        "note": (
            "This is a configuration and numerical-readiness cap, not an automatic upgrade. "
            "VALIDATED/PREDICTIVE still require sealed experimental evidence."
        ),
    }


def automatic_scale_diagnostics(
    cfg: SimulationConfig,
    model: FullCableModel | None = None,
    equilibrium: StaticEquilibrium | None = None,
    loaded_positions: np.ndarray | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return run-specific scale, scope, observability and claim diagnostics.

    ``equilibrium`` is optional because UI previews may call this before a full
    static solve.  In that case the mechanically informed H1 reference geometry
    is used and the report states that it is only an estimate.
    """

    model = FullCableModel(cfg) if model is None else model
    raw = model.diagnostics()
    p, _q = cfg.analysis.target_ratio
    phase_tol = float(to_si(cfg.analysis.phase_tolerance, default_unit="rad"))
    epsilon_req = phase_tol / (2.0 * math.pi * p * max(cfg.analysis.slow_period_count, 1))

    if loaded_positions is not None:
        positions = np.asarray(loaded_positions, dtype=float)
        geometry_state = "provided_loaded_state"
    elif equilibrium is not None:
        positions = np.asarray(equilibrium.positions, dtype=float)
        geometry_state = "static_equilibrium"
    else:
        positions = np.asarray(model.topology.reference_positions, dtype=float)
        geometry_state = "mechanically_informed_reference_guess"
    if positions.shape != (model.topology.node_count, 3):
        raise ValueError(
            f"loaded_positions must have shape {(model.topology.node_count, 3)}, got {positions.shape}."
        )
    element_vector = (
        positions[model.topology.elements.node_j]
        - positions[model.topology.elements.node_i]
    )
    element_length = np.linalg.norm(element_vector, axis=1)
    loaded_strain = np.maximum(
        element_length / model.topology.elements.rest_length - 1.0,
        0.0,
    )
    if geometry_state in {"static_equilibrium", "provided_loaded_state"}:
        extension_estimate = float(np.max(loaded_strain))
        extension_estimate_source = geometry_state
    else:
        extension_estimate = float(raw["epsilon_extension_estimate"])
        extension_estimate_source = "conservative_force_scale_bound"
    A = positions[model.topology.support_nodes[0]]
    B = positions[model.topology.support_nodes[1]]
    J = positions[model.topology.junction_node]
    P = positions[model.topology.bob_node]
    loaded_geometry = reduced_geometry_from_loaded_state(A, B, J, model.gravity)
    lower_loaded = float(np.linalg.norm(P - J))
    slow_length = max(loaded_geometry.h + lower_loaded, 1e-15)
    gmag = float(np.linalg.norm(model.gravity))
    omega_fast = math.sqrt(gmag / max(lower_loaded, 1e-15))
    omega_slow = math.sqrt(gmag / slow_length)
    frequency_fast = omega_fast / (2.0 * math.pi)
    frequency_slow = omega_slow / (2.0 * math.pi)
    characteristic_length = slow_length

    phi, theta, amplitude_source = _initial_amplitude(cfg)
    if phi is None or theta is None:
        amplitude = None
        finite_amplitude = None
    else:
        amplitude = max(phi, theta)
        # Conservative order-of-magnitude bound including cross-frequency terms.
        finite_amplitude = max(phi * phi, theta * theta) * 3.0 / 16.0

    cable_mass = float(np.sum(model.topology.elements.element_mass))
    bob_mass = model.bob_mass
    junction_ratio = model.junction_mass / bob_mass
    string_ratio = cable_mass / bob_mass
    radius = float(to_si(cfg.bob.radius, default_unit="m"))
    radius_ratio = radius / characteristic_length

    times = model.characteristic_times()
    output_dt = float(to_si(cfg.solver.output_dt, default_unit="s"))
    t_end = float(to_si(cfg.solver.t_end, default_unit="s"))
    internal_max_step = _effective_step(cfg, model)
    minimum_crossing = times["minimum_element_wave_crossing"]
    output_samples_fast_period = 1.0 / max(frequency_fast * output_dt, 1e-30)
    output_samples_slow_period = 1.0 / max(frequency_slow * output_dt, 1e-30)
    slow_cycles = t_end * frequency_slow
    internal_steps_crossing = minimum_crossing / max(internal_max_step, 1e-30)
    output_samples_crossing = minimum_crossing / max(output_dt, 1e-30)
    low_frequency_sampling_ok = output_samples_fast_period >= 20.0
    stationary_frequency_window_ok = slow_cycles >= 3.0
    wave_internal_ok = cfg.solver.resolve_longitudinal_waves and internal_steps_crossing >= 20.0
    wave_output_ok = output_samples_crossing >= 2.0
    retension_peak_ready = wave_internal_ok and wave_output_ok

    E = model.topology.elements.ea / model.topology.elements.area
    c_longitudinal = np.sqrt(E / model.topology.elements.density)
    cable_wave_eps: dict[str, float] = {}
    cable_loss_factor: dict[str, float] = {}
    for name, sl in model.topology.cable_slices.items():
        length = float(np.sum(model.topology.elements.rest_length[sl]))
        c_min = float(np.min(c_longitudinal[sl]))
        cable_wave_eps[name] = omega_fast * length / max(c_min, 1e-30)
        eta = model.topology.elements.eta_a[sl] / model.topology.elements.area[sl]
        young = E[sl]
        cable_loss_factor[name] = float(np.max(omega_fast * eta / young))

    support_amplitudes: list[float] = []
    for support in (cfg.supports.A, cfg.supports.B):
        if support.type == "prescribed" and support.motion is not None:
            support_amplitudes.append(
                float(np.linalg.norm(as_vector3(support.motion.amplitude, default_unit="m")))
            )
    support_ratio = max(support_amplitudes, default=0.0) / characteristic_length

    air_density = float(to_si(cfg.environment.air_density, default_unit="kg/m^3"))
    velocity_scale = (
        omega_fast * characteristic_length * amplitude
        if amplitude is not None
        else float("nan")
    )
    bob_drag_ratio: float | None = None
    string_drag_ratio: float | None = None
    if cfg.bob.drag.enabled and np.isfinite(velocity_scale):
        cd = float(to_si(cfg.bob.drag.cd, default_unit="dimensionless"))
        linear = float(to_si(cfg.bob.drag.linear_coefficient, default_unit="N*s/m"))
        drag = 0.5 * air_density * cd * math.pi * radius**2 * velocity_scale**2 + linear * velocity_scale
        bob_drag_ratio = drag / max(bob_mass * gmag, 1e-30)
    if any(getattr(cfg.cables, name).drag_enabled for name in ("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower")) and np.isfinite(velocity_scale):
        force = 0.0
        for name in ("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower"):
            cable = getattr(cfg.cables, name)
            if cable.drag_enabled:
                length = float(to_si(cable.rest_length, default_unit="m"))
                diameter = float(to_si(cable.diameter, default_unit="m"))
                force += 0.5 * air_density * cable.drag_cd_normal * diameter * length * velocity_scale**2
        string_drag_ratio = force / max(bob_mass * gmag, 1e-30)
    buoyancy_ratio = (
        air_density * (4.0 / 3.0) * math.pi * radius**3 / bob_mass if cfg.bob.buoyancy else 0.0
    )

    a_a = loaded_geometry.a_a
    a_b = loaded_geometry.a_b
    h = loaded_geometry.h
    if h > 1e-15 and min(a_a, a_b) > 0.0:
        fast_slack_limit = min(math.atan(a_a / h), math.atan(a_b / h))
    else:
        fast_slack_limit = 0.0
    slack_margin = None if phi is None else fast_slack_limit - phi

    natural_a = float(to_si(cfg.cables.upper_A.rest_length, default_unit="m"))
    natural_b = float(to_si(cfg.cables.upper_B.rest_length, default_unit="m"))
    support_spacing = float(np.linalg.norm(B - A))
    prestretch_geometry_fraction = max(support_spacing / (natural_a + natural_b) - 1.0, 0.0)

    effects = {
        "unilateral_tension_and_slack": {
            "estimate": None,
            "classification": "structural_required",
            "reason": "A loss of a serial tensile path changes the active mechanical topology.",
        },
        "finite_amplitude": {
            "estimate_relative_frequency_upper_scale": finite_amplitude,
            "classification": _classify(finite_amplitude, epsilon_req),
            "source": amplitude_source,
        },
        "junction_mass": {
            "estimate_mass_ratio": junction_ratio,
            "classification": _classify(junction_ratio, epsilon_req),
        },
        "string_mass": {
            "estimate_frequency_scale": string_ratio / 12.0,
            "mass_ratio": string_ratio,
            "classification": _classify(string_ratio / 12.0, epsilon_req),
        },
        "axial_extension": {
            "estimate_strain_scale": extension_estimate,
            "estimate_source": extension_estimate_source,
            "classification": _classify(extension_estimate, epsilon_req),
            "small_strain_assumption_warning": bool(extension_estimate > 0.02),
        },
        "longitudinal_wave_dynamics": {
            "estimate_omega_L_over_c": max(cable_wave_eps.values()),
            "per_cable": cable_wave_eps,
            "classification": (
                "retain"
                if cfg.solver.resolve_longitudinal_waves
                else _classify(max(cable_wave_eps.values()), epsilon_req)
            ),
        },
        "material_axial_loss": {
            "estimate_loss_factor": max(cable_loss_factor.values()),
            "per_cable": cable_loss_factor,
            "classification": _classify(max(cable_loss_factor.values()), epsilon_req),
        },
        "bob_finite_size": {
            "estimate_radius_over_length": radius_ratio,
            "classification": "negligible",
            "reason": (
                "The frozen core connects the cable force through the bob centre of mass. "
                "Radius affects aerodynamic area and buoyancy, not rigid-body inertia."
            ),
        },
        "bob_aerodynamics": {
            "estimate_force_over_weight": bob_drag_ratio,
            "classification": (
                "negligible"
                if not cfg.bob.drag.enabled
                else _classify(bob_drag_ratio, epsilon_req)
            ),
        },
        "string_aerodynamics": {
            "estimate_force_over_weight": string_drag_ratio,
            "classification": (
                "negligible"
                if not any(getattr(cfg.cables, name).drag_enabled for name in ("upper_A", "upper_B", "lower"))
                else _classify(string_drag_ratio, epsilon_req)
            ),
        },
        "buoyancy": {
            "estimate_displaced_air_mass_over_bob_mass": buoyancy_ratio,
            "classification": _classify(buoyancy_ratio, epsilon_req),
        },
        "prescribed_support_motion": {
            "estimate_amplitude_over_length": support_ratio,
            "classification": (
                "negligible" if support_ratio == 0.0 else _classify(support_ratio, epsilon_req)
            ),
        },
        "bending_and_torsion": {
            "estimate": None,
            "classification": "unknown",
            "reason": (
                "EI/GJ and connection moment transfer are outside the v1.0 input contract. "
                "The run is high-fidelity only within the axial-cable scope."
            ),
        },
    }

    numerical_warnings: list[str] = []
    if not low_frequency_sampling_ok:
        numerical_warnings.append(
            f"Only {output_samples_fast_period:.2f} stored samples per estimated fast period; low-frequency trajectory analysis is under-sampled."
        )
    if not stationary_frequency_window_ok:
        numerical_warnings.append(
            f"Only {slow_cycles:.2f} estimated slow cycles are simulated; stationary frequency/closure fitting is not supportable."
        )
    if cfg.solver.resolve_longitudinal_waves and not wave_internal_ok:
        numerical_warnings.append(
            f"Internal step resolves the fastest element wave crossing with only {internal_steps_crossing:.2f} steps (<20)."
        )
    if cfg.solver.resolve_longitudinal_waves and not wave_output_ok:
        numerical_warnings.append(
            f"Stored output has only {output_samples_crossing:.3g} samples per fastest wave crossing; retension peak output is aliased."
        )
    if not cfg.solver.resolve_longitudinal_waves:
        numerical_warnings.append(
            "Longitudinal-wave resolution is disabled; low-frequency motion may be studied after convergence, but retension peak and cable-wave claims are not resolved."
        )

    if extension_estimate > 0.02:
        numerical_warnings.append(
            f"Estimated tensile strain reaches {extension_estimate:.3%}; the default small-strain linear axial law requires independent calibration over this range or a tabulated material curve."
        )

    scope_findings: list[str] = []
    # The current schema cannot express eccentric attachment, bending stiffness,
    # self-contact or sliding.  We therefore avoid inventing an out-of-scope
    # finding unless a measurable geometric proxy already contradicts the core.
    gravity_axis_cosine = abs(
        float(np.dot((B - A) / np.linalg.norm(B - A), model.gravity / gmag))
    )
    if gravity_axis_cosine > 0.98:
        scope_findings.append(
            "Support axis is almost parallel to gravity; the conventional suspended Y branch and modal interpretation are ill-conditioned."
        )

    provenance = parameter_provenance_audit(cfg)
    claim = _claim_readiness(
        cfg,
        provenance,
        numerical_warnings=numerical_warnings,
        scope_findings=scope_findings,
    )

    return {
        "diagnostic_version": "1.1",
        "geometry_state": geometry_state,
        "epsilon_required_for_phase_budget": epsilon_req,
        "estimated_low_frequency": {
            "fast_hz": frequency_fast,
            "slow_hz": frequency_slow,
            "ratio": frequency_fast / frequency_slow,
            "fast_period_s": 1.0 / frequency_fast,
            "slow_period_s": 1.0 / frequency_slow,
        },
        "geometry": {
            "support_spacing_m": support_spacing,
            "loaded_upper_drop_m": h,
            "loaded_lower_length_m": lower_loaded,
            "characteristic_length_m": characteristic_length,
            "fast_slack_limit_rad_estimate": fast_slack_limit,
            "configured_fast_amplitude_rad": phi,
            "fast_slack_margin_rad_estimate": slack_margin,
            "natural_geometry_prestretch_fraction": prestretch_geometry_fraction,
            "gravity_support_axis_absolute_cosine": gravity_axis_cosine,
        },
        "dimensionless": {
            "epsilon_junction": junction_ratio,
            "epsilon_string_mass": string_ratio,
            "epsilon_extension_estimate": extension_estimate,
            "epsilon_extension_estimate_source": extension_estimate_source,
            "epsilon_amplitude_rad": amplitude,
            "epsilon_bob_radius": radius_ratio,
            "epsilon_support_motion": support_ratio,
            "epsilon_wave_max": max(cable_wave_eps.values()),
        },
        "effects": effects,
        "observability_and_resolution": {
            "simulation_duration_s": t_end,
            "stored_output_dt_s": output_dt,
            "effective_internal_max_step_s": internal_max_step,
            "estimated_slow_cycles": slow_cycles,
            "stored_samples_per_fast_period": output_samples_fast_period,
            "stored_samples_per_slow_period": output_samples_slow_period,
            "internal_steps_per_fastest_element_wave_crossing": internal_steps_crossing,
            "stored_samples_per_fastest_element_wave_crossing": output_samples_crossing,
            "low_frequency_sampling_ready": low_frequency_sampling_ok,
            "stationary_frequency_window_ready": stationary_frequency_window_ok,
            "longitudinal_wave_internal_ready": wave_internal_ok,
            "longitudinal_wave_output_ready": wave_output_ok,
            "retension_peak_prediction_ready": retension_peak_ready,
            "warnings": numerical_warnings,
        },
        "parameter_provenance": provenance,
        "scope_findings": scope_findings,
        "claim_readiness": claim,
        "raw_model_diagnostics": raw,
    }


def assess_result_validity(
    cfg: SimulationConfig,
    model: FullCableModel,
    result: SimulationResult,
    *,
    preflight: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Assess whether a completed H1 run supports its requested observables."""

    preflight = automatic_scale_diagnostics(cfg, model) if preflight is None else preflight
    findings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    max_energy = float(np.max(np.abs(result.energy["balance_residual"])))
    max_strain = float(np.max(np.maximum(result.stretch / model.topology.elements.rest_length[None, :], 0.0)))
    structural_events = [
        event
        for event in result.events
        if event.get("type")
        in {
            "cable_slack",
            "cable_retension",
            "cable_initially_not_fully_taut",
            "cable_fully_unloaded",
            "cable_first_local_retension",
            "upper_branch_switch",
        }
    ]
    if max_energy > (1e-6 if cfg.solver.profile == "reference" else 1e-4):
        findings.append(
            {
                "severity": "error",
                "code": "energy_balance_not_accepted",
                "value": max_energy,
            }
        )
    if max_strain > 0.02:
        findings.append(
            {
                "severity": "warning",
                "code": "small_axial_strain_assumption_stressed",
                "value": max_strain,
            }
        )
    if model.material_extrapolation_seen:
        findings.append(
            {
                "severity": "error",
                "code": "material_curve_extrapolated",
                "cables": sorted(model.material_extrapolation_seen),
            }
        )
    if structural_events:
        findings.append(
            {
                "severity": "info",
                "code": "structural_switching_present",
                "event_count": len(structural_events),
                "meaning": "A stationary two-frequency Lissajous fit is not globally valid.",
            }
        )
    if not preflight["observability_and_resolution"]["retension_peak_prediction_ready"] and any(
        event.get("type") in {"cable_retension", "cable_first_local_retension", "element_retension"}
        for event in result.events
    ):
        findings.append(
            {
                "severity": "error",
                "code": "retension_detected_but_peak_not_resolved",
            }
        )
    status = "pass"
    if any(item["severity"] == "error" for item in findings):
        status = "fail"
    elif findings:
        status = "conditional"
    return {
        "status": status,
        "max_abs_energy_balance_residual": max_energy,
        "maximum_tensile_strain": max_strain,
        "structural_event_count": len(structural_events),
        "findings": findings,
        "observable_support": {
            "low_frequency_motion": bool(
                preflight["observability_and_resolution"]["low_frequency_sampling_ready"]
            ),
            "stationary_two_frequency_fit": bool(
                preflight["observability_and_resolution"]["stationary_frequency_window_ready"]
                and not structural_events
            ),
            "cable_waveform": bool(
                preflight["observability_and_resolution"]["longitudinal_wave_internal_ready"]
                and preflight["observability_and_resolution"]["longitudinal_wave_output_ready"]
            ),
            "retension_peak": bool(
                preflight["observability_and_resolution"]["retension_peak_prediction_ready"]
            ),
        },
    }
~~~~

# Layer 3 source: src/ypendulum/io/hdf5.py

~~~~python
"""HDF5 run format with units and descriptions."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import h5py
import numpy as np

from ypendulum.hf.state import HighFidelityResult
from ypendulum.models.state import SimulationResult


def _dataset(
    h5: h5py.File,
    name: str,
    data: Any,
    *,
    unit: str,
    description: str,
    compression: bool = True,
):
    arr = np.asarray(data)
    kwargs = {"compression": "gzip", "shuffle": True} if compression and arr.size > 32 else {}
    ds = h5.create_dataset(name, data=arr, **kwargs)
    ds.attrs["unit"] = unit
    ds.attrs["description"] = description
    return ds


def write_h1_result(
    path: str | Path,
    result: SimulationResult,
    model,
    observer_pixels=None,
    observer_time=None,
) -> None:
    target = Path(path)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with h5py.File(target, "w") as h5:
        h5.attrs["format"] = "YP-FPSim H1 result"
        h5.attrs["format_version"] = "1.0"
        h5.attrs["model"] = result.model_name
        h5.attrs["claim_level"] = result.claim_level
        _dataset(h5, "/time", result.time, unit="s", description="Absolute simulation time")
        _dataset(
            h5,
            "/state/positions",
            result.positions,
            unit="m",
            description="All mesh-node world positions; shape (time,node,xyz)",
        )
        _dataset(
            h5,
            "/state/velocities",
            result.velocities,
            unit="m/s",
            description="All mesh-node world velocities",
        )
        string_type = h5py.string_dtype(encoding="utf-8")
        labels = h5.create_dataset(
            "/mesh/node_labels",
            data=np.asarray(model.topology.node_labels, dtype=object),
            dtype=string_type,
        )
        labels.attrs["unit"] = "1"
        labels.attrs["description"] = "Stable mesh-node labels"
        _dataset(
            h5,
            "/mesh/elements/node_i",
            model.topology.elements.node_i,
            unit="1",
            description="Element first-node indices",
        )
        _dataset(
            h5,
            "/mesh/elements/node_j",
            model.topology.elements.node_j,
            unit="1",
            description="Element second-node indices",
        )
        _dataset(
            h5,
            "/mesh/elements/rest_length",
            model.topology.elements.rest_length,
            unit="m",
            description="Element natural lengths",
        )
        j = model.topology.junction_node
        b = model.topology.bob_node
        _dataset(h5, "/bodies/junction/position", result.positions[:, j], unit="m", description="Junction position")
        _dataset(h5, "/bodies/junction/velocity", result.velocities[:, j], unit="m/s", description="Junction velocity")
        _dataset(h5, "/bodies/bob/position", result.positions[:, b], unit="m", description="Bob centre-of-mass position")
        _dataset(h5, "/bodies/bob/velocity", result.velocities[:, b], unit="m/s", description="Bob centre-of-mass velocity")
        for name, sl in model.topology.cable_slices.items():
            path_nodes = model.topology.cable_node_paths[name]
            _dataset(
                h5,
                f"/cables/{name}/nodes/position",
                result.positions[:, path_nodes],
                unit="m",
                description=f"{name} cable node positions",
            )
            _dataset(
                h5,
                f"/cables/{name}/nodes/velocity",
                result.velocities[:, path_nodes],
                unit="m/s",
                description=f"{name} cable node velocities",
            )
            _dataset(
                h5,
                f"/cables/{name}/elements/tension",
                result.tension[:, sl],
                unit="N",
                description=f"{name} element axial tension; never negative",
            )
            _dataset(
                h5,
                f"/cables/{name}/elements/stretch",
                result.stretch[:, sl],
                unit="m",
                description=f"{name} current length minus rest length",
            )
            _dataset(
                h5,
                f"/cables/{name}/elements/active",
                result.active[:, sl].astype(np.uint8),
                unit="1",
                description=f"{name} unilateral tensile active flag",
            )
        _dataset(h5, "/reactions/support_A", result.reactions["support_A"], unit="N", description="Reaction exerted by support A on the system")
        _dataset(h5, "/reactions/support_B", result.reactions["support_B"], unit="N", description="Reaction exerted by support B on the system")
        energy_units = {
            "kinetic": "J",
            "gravitational": "J",
            "elastic": "J",
            "mechanical": "J",
            "material_dissipation_rate": "W",
            "aero_relative_dissipation_rate": "W",
            "aero_work_rate": "W",
            "support_work_rate": "W",
            "dissipation_material": "J",
            "dissipation_aero_relative": "J",
            "aero_work": "J",
            "support_work": "J",
            "balance_residual": "1",
        }
        for key, values in result.energy.items():
            _dataset(
                h5,
                f"/energy/{key}",
                values,
                unit=energy_units.get(key, "1"),
                description=key.replace("_", " "),
            )
        if "dissipation_aero_relative" in result.energy:
            _dataset(
                h5,
                "/energy/dissipation_aero",
                result.energy["dissipation_aero_relative"],
                unit="J",
                description="Cumulative aerodynamic dissipation relative to the air",
            )
        if observer_pixels is not None:
            _dataset(h5, "/observer/pixels", observer_pixels, unit="pixel", description="Predicted camera pixels")
            if observer_time is None:
                raise ValueError("observer_time is required whenever observer_pixels are written.")
            _dataset(
                h5,
                "/observer/time",
                observer_time,
                unit="s",
                description="Observer sample mid-exposure times",
            )


def read_h1_result(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    with h5py.File(path, "r") as h5:
        out["time"] = np.asarray(h5["/time"])
        out["positions"] = np.asarray(h5["/state/positions"])
        out["velocities"] = np.asarray(h5["/state/velocities"])
        out["bob_position"] = np.asarray(h5["/bodies/bob/position"])
        out["junction_position"] = np.asarray(h5["/bodies/junction/position"])
        out["energy_balance_residual"] = np.asarray(h5["/energy/balance_residual"])
        out["model"] = h5.attrs.get("model", "H1")
        out["claim_level"] = h5.attrs.get("claim_level", "VERIFIED")
    return out


def write_hf_result(path: str | Path, result: HighFidelityResult, model) -> None:
    """Write the complete independent-HF state with explicit SI identity."""

    target = Path(path)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with h5py.File(target, "w") as h5:
        h5.attrs["format"] = "Y-Pendulum independent HF result"
        h5.attrs["format_version"] = "1.0"
        h5.attrs["model"] = result.model_id
        h5.attrs["units"] = "SI"
        h5.attrs["physical_status"] = result.physical_status
        h5.attrs["numerical_status"] = result.numerical_status
        h5.attrs["valid_interval_start_s"] = result.valid_interval[0]

        string_type = h5py.string_dtype(encoding="utf-8")
~~~~
